author: Nhi Huynh
review_text: Nong - Farm to Grill is a hidden gem in Ho Chi Minh City, offering a unique farm-to-table dining experience. The menu highlights fresh, high-quality ingredients, expertly grilled to perfection. The meats are tender and flavorful, while the vegetable sides are vibrant and well-seasoned. The cozy, rustic ambiance adds to the charm, making it a perfect spot for a casual dinner or a special occasion. The staff is attentive and knowledgeable about the menu, enhancing the overall experience. If you’re a fan of wholesome, thoughtfully prepared meals, Nong is a must-try.

review_text: First of all, Nong would like to sincerely thank you for taking the time to evaluate and share your opinions about the quality of service and food at Nong. Your feedback is a source of motivation for Nong to constantly improve and enhance … More

author: Ngoc Minh
review_text:
The restaurant near my house is always crowded with customers. I went to the restaurant on a weekday and booked a table in advance, so I didn't have to wait, I got a table right away. Because it was a weekday, it wasn't crowded, although I saw customers coming and going constantly, there were still many empty tables in the back. 
The staff were friendly and enthusiastic, and the order was taken very quickly. 
The food we ordered was quite a lot. 
The grilled pork belly and sturgeon with green mustard were delicious, the meat was soft and moist, the restaurant used medium charcoal, the fire wasn't too big and smoky like other restaurants, it took a bit longer to grill but it was worth the wait. The jellyfish salad was okay, with a little jellyfish it was a bit boring to eat. The chicken cartilage was normal. Everyone praised the crab and sweet potato vermicelli, so I ordered a portion. The vermicelli made the sauce richer, there was real crab meat but it was dry, I didn't like this dish. The avocado salad and fried taro were delicious, very attractive. The fried sturgeon cartilage was firm, the grilled fish was soft and delicious, there was a lot of garlic. The vegetable tray was big like its name. As for the drinks, they were all similar, the lemon tea was strange and strange, I couldn't get used to it. Overall, the food was okay. 300 fish per person was enough to fill us up.

author: Uyên Nguyễn Ngọc Phương
review_text: The meat is fresh and tender, but the ribs should be scored or divided into long strips to make it easier to grill. The jellyfish salad is not very harmonious in taste, the spicy taste is overwhelming the other ingredients. The restaurant has a dish of salted leaves with fragrant flavor, which goes well with the meat. In addition, the vegetable tray is fresh and the portion is just right.

author: Nguyen Van
review_text: The ambiance is beautiful, the food is delicious, and the prices are reasonable. The staff are enthusiastic and take good care of the customers.

author: Thanh NGO

author: Andrew Truong
review_text: This place is huge with private rooms but you’ll have to book early because it is very busy! They do several course meals depending on what you choose. Usually hosts parties and events so not the place you go to if you want a quiet evening. Service was great

author: Czar Esterak
review_text: We had a truly great evening at this restaurant. The food was delicious, fresh, and perfectly prepared. The service was friendly, efficient, and professional, which made us feel well taken care of. The atmosphere was welcoming and pleasant, creating a comfortable place to relax and enjoy our meal. It was a wonderful overall experience.

author: Sang Chau
review_text: Nice place with local food for a gathering or birthday party. The food is fresh and the taste is really good and really Vietnamese. It is really crowded during weekends, the staff in the parking lot is really supportive to help guests to park their car/bike but since in weekend, it's really crowded so take time to park so prepare extra time for this.

author: Khanh Khanh
review_text: We ordered a variety of grilled fish, pork, and vegetables, all cooked to perfection. Excellent service, and an authentic cultural dining experience. Whether you're looking for a casual meal or a special dinner with friends and family, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit. I’ll be coming back for sure!

author: hung nguyen
review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Làng Nướng Nam Bộ and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. From the moment I stepped foot into the restaurant, I was greeted with warm hospitality and a cozy ambiance that set the stage for a memorable evening.

The highlight of my visit was undoubtedly the delectable array of grilled dishes. Làng Nướng Nam Bộ truly knows how to bring out the flavors in their dishes, as each bite was bursting with succulent and perfectly cooked meats. Whether it was the tender grilled beef, the flavorful marinated chicken, or the fresh seafood, every dish was a delightful combination of textures and tastes.

What impressed me even more was the attention to detail in their presentation. Each dish was beautifully arranged, showcasing the culinary artistry that goes into their creations. The vibrant colors and enticing aromas added to the overall sensory experience, making the meal even more enjoyable.

Not only was the food exceptional, but the service was top-notch as well. The staff at Làng Nướng Nam Bộ were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. They took the time to explain the menu options and offer recommendations, ensuring that every guest had a personalized dining experience.

The restaurant itself boasts a charming and cozy atmosphere, making it the perfect place to enjoy a meal with friends, family, or that special someone. The spacious seating arrangements and tasteful decor create a welcoming ambiance that enhances the dining experience.

author: Thu Hương Phạm
review_text:
Recently, my company held a party here. My first impression was that the VIP room was quite airy and had good lighting. However, I found the air conditioning position to be not very suitable. If the temperature was set low for people on the edge to be cool, people in the middle right under the air conditioner would be very cold.

Regarding the food, there was a wide variety of dishes, the prices were a bit high.

Regarding the taste of the food, I generally found it a bit salty. Almost all the dishes were like that. There was a cheese beef dish with a delicious sauce, but when I ate the beef, it was salty, so I felt a bit regretful.

The restroom was clean and had air conditioning.

author: Nhut Le Quang
review_text:
Ideal place to organize meetings, including wedding parties because there are many halls with 5-10 tables. There are open spaces and private rooms, serving a variety of guests.

The front gate of the restaurant is easy to recognize because it is the busiest on the street. There are many staff guiding parking to avoid traffic jams, and staff guiding to the banquet hall.
There is an elevator but it is often overloaded if there are many parties on the weekend. I had to use the stairs because I didn't want to waste time waiting.
The toilet on the ground floor had air conditioning when I went, but the 3rd floor did not.

The food was also quite tasty. The party menu was quite diverse.
Opening hours are until 22:30 but there is support for extra guests if the fun is not over yet. I am weak so I didn't stay until that time to check :D

Come to have a party at the restaurant around the end of the year, there are Christmas decorations with many more virtual living corners

author: Duc Lq
review_text:
The road is easy to go, motorbikes are parked opposite, remember to cross the road, this part is a bit reckless.
The VIP room upstairs is spacious and okay, the hallway is too much smoking and there is no ventilation so the smoke fills the hallway.
The food is okay, the service is okay.
The investment in seasonal decoration.

author: Phuoc Long Nguyen
review_text:
Nam Bo Grilled Village is located on Duong Duc Hien Street, Tay Thanh Ward, Tan Phu District, an ideal culinary destination for those who love traditional grilled dishes with rich Southern flavors. The restaurant's location is quite easy to find, located right in a busy residential area and convenient for travel, with a spacious parking lot, so it is very convenient for both motorbikes and cars. 

The restaurant space is spacious and airy with a style close to nature, imbued with the Southern style. The restaurant has many areas, suitable for many different groups of guests such as families, friends, or company parties. The space is very sparkling when lit up in the evening, creating a cozy but equally comfortable feeling. 

Regarding food, the restaurant serves a variety of grilled dishes - from seafood, beef, chicken to rustic dishes such as hot pot with fish sauce, grilled snakehead fish, grilled chicken with salt and chili... The flavor of the dishes is rich, delicious, the ingredients are fresh and delicious, and the preparation is standard. In particular, the dipping sauce here is very unique, contributing to enhancing the flavor of the grilled dishes. 

The staff is friendly, quick and enthusiastic. Even though the restaurant is crowded, you still don't have to wait too long to order. The price is reasonable compared to the quality and space it provides. 

Overall, this is an ideal place to enjoy Southern cuisine in the heart of Saigon, from seafood, beef, chicken to rustic dishes such as fish sauce hotpot, grilled snakehead fish, grilled chicken with salt and chili... The flavor of the dishes is rich, delicious, the ingredients are fresh and well-prepared. In particular, the dipping sauce here is very unique, contributing to enhancing the flavor of the dish!

review_text: The food was okay, but the staff seemed to be rushing the guests to eat quickly and leave; the party started at 8 PM, but all the dishes were served by 8:45 PM. It was like they wanted us to eat quickly, clean up, and go to sleep or something.

author: Lê Bảo Trân Trần
review_text: Yesterday was my first experience at The Chill's Tay Thanh branch, but it was really terrible! I won't comment on the food because everyone has different tastes, so I won't give a detailed review. But the important thing is, the staff seem to lack proper training. I arrived at 6 PM and stayed until 8 PM. From the moment I bought my ticket until I started eating, I had a very unpleasant experience with the staff. The service was incredibly poor. The staff were all standing around, in clumps, and when I needed a grill change, no one came to help. There was absolutely no quick response, even though my table was burning and smoke was billowing everywhere. They just crowded around chatting and were very impolite. I really disliked the staff's attitude. Many of them were even staring intently at our table. Overall, I was extremely disappointed.

I called the staff and was instructed to go back to the restaurant to check the camera, but it was raining heavily and my house was far away so I didn't go back. The damage was small (100-200k) but quite annoying.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Thuỷ Tiên Lê
review_text:
I visited this grilled meat buffet restaurant because the reviews were okay (maybe because the staff asked for reviews :)))), but the actual experience was quite disappointing. The meat was okay, not too special. The appetizer line was cold and not delicious. There were a few staff so sometimes I had to call once or twice to be served, but they were still very enthusiastic, especially the staff who changed the grill and helped with table reservations - I still appreciate this 👍

However, after finishing the meal, I had a stomachache and quite severe diarrhea. I don't know if it was because of the food or how it was preserved, especially the kimchi that showed signs of being expired (sour and very smelly) which really made me uncomfortable. Plus, when I changed the grill, there was a lot of detergent left on the grill.

Although it was only 139k, I can't ask for much. I hope the restaurant will review the hygiene and food quality, because this experience makes me not dare to come back.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Bảo Phạm
review_text: The grilled food was okay, marinated but still tasted bland when grilled! The fried food counter was bad and cold. When a staff member asked for help, they were confused (there were a few male staff members who were still enthusiastic). It was raining and the food leaked? When the staff asked to go upstairs to eat, the staff had already arranged all the seats for new customers, but there was no more room for the old customers who had just had a leak like me? When we took them upstairs above the kitchen, the food still leaked. The experience at this restaurant was really bad. This is the first time I have had to review a restaurant and give it 1* like this. The restaurant should retrain the staff and fix the roof!

review_text: The restaurant is crowded during peak hours, so reservations are recommended. The fast food is flavorful, and the ingredients for grilled and hot pot dishes are replenished continuously. The drinks are okay 👌, with ice cream and desserts. The food is decent, with many choices, and the staff are enthusiastic and provide good service ❤

author: Đại Dương Nguyễn
review_text:
Pinkpong Buffet is a dining destination well worth experiencing, especially for those who love a youthful atmosphere and diverse cuisine. From the moment I entered, I was impressed by the modern decor, the cute color scheme, the cleanliness, and the comfortable feeling it created for diners. The tables and chairs were neatly arranged, suitable for groups of friends, families, or celebratory meals.

The most outstanding feature of Pinkpong Buffet is the quality of the food. The dishes are attractively presented and diverse, ranging from grilled meats, seafood, fried dishes, side dishes, to desserts. The food is fresh, seasoned perfectly, and the grilled dishes are particularly flavorful, aromatic, and not greasy. The dessert counter is also very appealing with many types of cakes, fruits, and sweets – you can eat them endlessly without getting bored.

In addition, the staff at Pinkpong are very quick, friendly, and enthusiastic in assisting customers when needed. The buffet price is reasonable compared to the quality and quantity of food, making it well worth the experience. Overall, Pinkpong buffet is an ideal choice for gathering, enjoying a fun meal, and savoring delicious food with family and friends.

author: Duyên Kỳ (My)
review_text:
Quality food, lots of it, reasonable price, fruit dessert ok, thank you Thu Ha for serving my table, taking care of customers ❤️

author: Hướng Dương Shop Hoa
review_text:
Basic prices range from 125,000 to ~155,000 VND/person, depending on the package (regular buffet or combo with hotpot).
Soft drink buffet package adds about 30,000 VND, and can include craft beer packages (~75K).
More than 40 diverse grilled dishes: American beef, pork belly, chicken wings, seafood such as shrimp, squid, octopus — marinated with special tamarind sauce, green chili salt, salted eggs, etc.
Dishes change seasonally to ensure fresh ingredients.
On-site processing line, fried food, desserts, fresh fruit, ice cream and detox water if you choose an additional package.
Youthful design, black-red color scheme combined with neon LED lights, vibrant party vibe, suitable for groups of friends or young families.
Spacious, airy space, neat tables and chairs, good distance between tables to avoid smoke and grease.
Friendly and enthusiastic staff.

author: huy phan
review_text: Anyone who doesn't want to eat there should go ahead :))) The portion is much smaller than advertised and it's VERY SWEET. Sweetness comes from the dipping sauce, side dishes, and pre-prepared meals. I'm from the Mekong Delta and I couldn't even eat it. The food isn't FRESH, it's VERY SWEET, VERY SWEET, VERY SWEET. One time, goodbye.

author: long vo hoang

author: Thu Hương Phạm
review_text:
The restaurant has a spacious, airy space, many seats, fully equipped with fans so it is quite cool.
The menu is diverse with many different dishes. There are grilled dishes, hot pot dishes and pre-cooked dishes. The price is reasonable, affordable. The taste is suitable for me and my group of friends.
The car will be parked right on the sidewalk in front of the restaurant, there is a parking attendant.
The downside of the restaurant is that we ordered fried squid eggs with fish sauce, our group mentioned it twice but still did not see this dish so in the end we paid. When asked, both times the staff responded that it was being prepared.
The bill was also a bit slow to pay.
The last point is that the restaurant gives away guava for dessert.

author: Ngô Tô
review_text: The restaurant has a spacious, airy, and cozy atmosphere, like having a drink on your own porch. The food is delicious and very reasonably priced. The bald-headed owner looks funny and cheerful; for some reason, he reminds me of Dien Ba Quang from The Smiling Proud Wanderer, haha.

author: Minh Hải Đoàn
review_text:
Booked a table and food in advance, but when I got to the restaurant, it was crowded so I couldn't read the order message in time, so I waited for 30 minutes.
Continued to order food and waited for 30 minutes but still didn't see the food, probably because the restaurant was crowded.
When I entered the restaurant, it was crowded so there was no staff to guide me to find a table, I actively went to find it but the staff was too busy, so I stood there for about 10 minutes before getting to the table.
When the food arrived, there was no dipping sauce, I asked twice, waited 15 minutes for the dipping sauce.
I don't blame the staff, the restaurant was too crowded.
In short, I won't visit the restaurant again, it was a pretty bad experience, I went with my family, waited for almost an hour and waited another 15 minutes for the dipping sauce.

author: Myly Tran
review_text: The restaurant space is airy, the dishes are diverse, suitable for the taste, especially there are delicious dipping sauces that go well with the dishes.

author: My
review_text: This restaurant is great, affordable, and delicious. I ordered a beef dish, and the slices were so thick and looked so satisfying! There was so much of it, and I couldn't believe it only cost 120,000 VND for such quality. I ate several other dishes and it didn't even cost 500,000 VND. The service was excellent, the restaurant was clean and spacious. I didn't expect a place in an alley to be this good. I'll definitely be back many times! 💕😚

author: Bảo Lâm Nguyễn Trần
review_text: Thank you for giving my family a delicious and cheap meal. The restaurant has a spacious, airy and clean space! Thank you!

author: DAT HO TUAN
review_text: This restaurant is cheap, the space is airy, there are 3 Karaoke rooms that can accommodate at least 20 people. The grilled dishes are the best, the service is average, generally affordable, the best thing is that the food is delicious, the drinks are good and cheap. Each person only spends about 200 - 300k. Where can you find a restaurant that is delicious, cool, and cheap? Saturday and Sunday are crowded, so go early.

author: Chau Chau
review_text:
In my opinion, the restaurant is affordable, we ate a lot of food for 6 people for only 900k. The service is also enthusiastic. But the dishes take a while to come out. I don't know if it's because the restaurant is still empty so the kitchen is not open or what.
In my opinion, the dishes are delicious, only the grilled breast with fermented bean curd is a bit salty, if possible, they should be grilled separately, dipping fermented bean curd according to the customer's preference.
The restaurant is very spacious, suitable for large parties.
One suggestion is that the restaurant should review the toilet a bit.
Add 10 points to the restaurant owner for being very enthusiastic.

author: Giang Hà
review_text: Great restaurant. Delicious, nutritious, cheap, cool, clean, beautiful, enthusiastic staff, funny owner, everyone should come and experience it. 10 points without any buts.

author: Tuân Nguyễn
review_text: The space is airy and comfortable, the food suits my taste, and the owner is friendly and enthusiastic.

author: Min Min
review_text: Cool restaurant, delicious food, reasonable price, the owner is very cute and friendly. Will always support the restaurant.

author: N Harris
review_text: The restaurant has a large sign at the beginning of the street, very easy to find, the space is spacious and airy, there are also private rooms with karaoke for those who want to have a private party, the food is very good, the price is surprisingly cheap, our group of 6 people ate their fill and only spent 1 million, the restaurant has a very enthusiastic owner, going to each table to greet customers, any problem that is not satisfactory, just give feedback, you can park your car.

author: NGUYEN KHUONG
review_text: The price is OK, the food is delicious, the owner is enthusiastic, I will come back to the restaurant 100%

author: Bảo Phan (ĂN NGON HÓC MÔN)
review_text:
DELICIOUS FOOD IN HOC MON.
The food is cheap and delicious. The beef tripe salad is amazing, the egg fried rice is only 30k, and they're currently running a promotion on a BBQ set for 149k, so good.

author: Nam Nguyễn
review_text:
Surprisingly cheap menu.
Spacious and airy space.
Has a large TV for football
Suitable for groups needing to organize parties
Friendly staff
There is a ball pit for children

author: Schwarz T
review_text: There is no waiter or waitress in the cold room to order food, so you have to go out to order. It's very boring. At least send someone to stay in the cold room to order food instead of standing up and going out to order.

author: Hoàng Nhi
review_text: Delicious food, friendly boss, happy and enthusiastic staff, will come again

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Carlos Rafael Fernandez
review_text: Cheap, yummy, clean. If you want Bun Thit Nuong, come to this place. For 30,000 vnd you get a really good meal.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Jay Nam
review_text: Not as good as the D1 location but still 5 stars for the food and nice parking attendant

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Joshua West
review_text: Good cheap food.  You have to order first then pick a seat.  Don't forget to ask for iced tea when ordering.  I wish the cashier would say "anything to drink?" Or " uống KHÔNG?"

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Quý Mai
review_text:
Kieu Bao's grilled pork vermicelli restaurant seems to be packed with customers all the time. I went there to eat and saw orders constantly coming and going on the app.

The full grilled pork vermicelli dish costs 33k VND as pictured, including grilled pork, grilled spring rolls, and fried spring rolls. The portion is decent for the price. A plus point is probably the fresh vegetables and pickles, which are refilled free once.

A downside is that the restaurant space is quite small, with tables and chairs placed close together, so it can feel a bit cramped and noisy when it's crowded. Parking is available in the alleyway with assistance.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: masaki k
review_text:
It seems to be a sister store in District 1, so I wanted to try it out, so I went! Parking is on the sidewalk in front of the store. No car parking is available. The store is on the first floor, so there's an ordering area in the middle. Everyone else was ordering on their smartphones, but I asked to see the menu, pointed at it, ordered, and paid on the spot. After that, you're given a receipt and a plate, which you hand to the staff inside the store and sit at the front and wait. What I ordered was different from last time, but the soup was in the same container with a plate on it, and you could pour it over the noodles to your liking. You can also add chili peppers to your liking. Then, add lots of vegetables and mix them together before eating.
The spring rolls were crispy and moist on the inside, the sautéed pork was tender, and the minced meat was very tasty. So, 34,000₫ (about 200 yen) is a bargain.
It's great that there are other stores in the same chain in the direction you're heading, so you can eat there no matter which way you go😃

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Tín Nguyễn Phúc
review_text:
The restaurant is a bit crowded so it feels a bit stuffy and not very comfortable.
The restaurant has a parking lot, so if you want to eat, go into the alley
The food here costs from 28k, I ordered a portion of meat and spring rolls for 32k.
I got an extra portion of vegetables and noodles for free.
Iced tea here is charged at 3k.
In general, the food is okay

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Phúc Nguyễn
review_text: Delicious grilled pork vermicelli with golden brown grilled pork, well marinated, served with soft rice noodles, fresh vegetables and sweet and sour fish sauce. The attractive blend of flavors, rich in Vietnamese, makes anyone who eats it fall in love.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Tâm Nguyễn Thị Thanh
review_text:
Today I visited Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Noodles restaurant, but the experience wasn't good. Parking was full, so I had to drive deep into the alley and park and move my motorbike myself; no one helped.

The staff were quite rude. When carrying food or clearing bowls, chopsticks, and spoons, they threw them into the trash can, creating a very unpleasant noise. The space was already noisy, and the service, which seemed to want to drive customers away, made the experience uncomfortable.
The grilled pork was also slightly burnt. I hope the restaurant reviews its service and food quality, because having such an experience while eating out is really unacceptable.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: N S
review_text: I'm a tourist, but after visiting AEON, I wanted to eat Bun Thit Nung, so I went there, knowing it wasn't a tourist spot. I ordered using the menu, got in line, and got my takeout right away. It's cheap, fast, delicious, and has a local food vibe, so I recommend it. It was a bit of a challenge walking from AEON, with some difficult crosswalks, but if you try, you can get there.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Mì Tôm Review dạo
review_text:
🥢 Review of Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Vermicelli

If you love grilled pork vermicelli, you should definitely try Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Vermicelli. I ate there recently and was very satisfied.

The first positive point is that the grilled pork is marinated very well, grilled evenly to a golden brown, and has a light layer of fat so it's not dry. The meat is tender, fragrant, and not overly burnt like at many other places.

The vermicelli portion is generous, the noodles are thin and soft, and it comes with clean and fresh vegetables. What I liked most was the pickled vegetables here; they're perfectly seasoned, not too sweet or too strong.

The dipping sauce is delicious and well-balanced, and it's incredibly addictive when poured over the vermicelli. Adding a bowl of spring rolls makes it even better.

A bowl of grilled pork vermicelli costs around 30k VND, and it's very filling.

Especially noteworthy is that the vermicelli and vegetables are FREE!

In short, if you like flavorful grilled pork vermicelli with delicious meat at an affordable price, Kieu Bao is a great choice!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Pu Lê
review_text: I ordered SPF but there was no fish sauce, so what am I supposed to eat? The restaurant intentionally provided the wrong phone number so I couldn't reach them; they're dishonest in their business practices!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Đi chơi
review_text:
If you want to wait, clean the table yourself, and go to the restaurant to order the food, I recommend it

but I sat and waited for 30 minutes without the food coming
the staff took the bill and lost it
when I went back to the cashier, they kept asking me to wait
?
experience 1/10

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: ngan vo
review_text: Buy fish sauce to take home and use it yourself? First time but the staff like qq didn't give any instructions, the food isn't special and it's expensive, first time is like last time

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Minh Anh Phạm
review_text: The food is incredibly delicious, and the prices are cheaper than many other places I've eaten at. Highly recommend! 👍👍👍

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: truong nguyen
review_text: The service is bad, the staff is understaffed, I keep ordering more noodles but they still don't come out.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Shen Leo
review_text: Delicious grilled meat, spring rolls, and rice noodles; reasonably priced and quite cheap. The initial portion size is just right, but if you want to be full, you can add extra vegetables and noodles for free, which is great!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Trần T Tuyết Nghi
review_text: We waited 20 minutes for our meal, people who arrived later got served first, and when we asked the staff, they were completely clueless and didn't know how to answer. I've been to many restaurants, but this one has the worst service.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: KASI PHƯƠNG
review_text: 📍 Space: Spacious, airy seating, but no air conditioning so it can be a bit hot at noon. 🧾 Service: There are many staff so the food comes out quickly, but you have to order at the counter first so it's a bit inconvenient if you go with a large group. When I went, the restaurant was quite empty, I saw the staff gathered together talking to each other, it didn't affect anything but it was a bit unprofessional. 🍜 Food: depends on your taste: flavorful grilled meat, well-mixed fish sauce, fresh vegetables. 🛵 Parking: There is parking in the alley, free for customers eating at the restaurant - a big plus!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Vy Thuý
review_text: The restaurant offers free extra noodles and vegetables, but for my appetite, one bowl like the one in the picture was enough to fill me up. The taste was pretty good.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Minh Vũ Quang
review_text: Delicious grilled spring rolls, free noodles and vegetables per person. Food comes out quickly.

author: Ida Jørgensen
review_text:
U ordered your food, get upstairs and give your ticket to the waitress, find an empty seat she will give u your food and drink in just a second. This restaurant only serve bun (cold dishes).
The food is really good at local price. The restaurant looks "ok", meaning u can see napkins on the floor here and there, but the tables were clean.
Question is,  would I be back to eat at this restaurant?  Definitely yes, the food is so good.

author: LexTeo8888
review_text:
Was trying to find the roast pork Banh mi and when I saw a long queue at this eatery, silly me thought this was it. Halfway through I realised they were selling grilled meats and vermicelli and decided why not.

Ordered a full set plus an additional plate of grilled meat and iced tea for VND76,000...which was very reasonable as there were proper seating and fans (no Aircon as per norm).

Was abit disgruntled when I was served the meats which were not even warm but all my disappointment disappeared when I tried my first taste. It was really not bad for a 4.1 Google rating. Not mind-blowing but I got my money's worth for sure!

What got me swooning was the chilli mixture that you put together with the fish sauce dipping. It was spicy 🔥 but in a good way! Really elevated the dining experience from not bad to good!

Gave only 4 stars though as this is Vietnam and I have higher expectations whereas if this was served to me in Singapore...maybe 4.5.

author: Stephen Romans
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Kieu Bao Barbecue Rice Noodles was one of the best meals I had on this trip—I loved it so much I went back twice. They have an easy-to-read English menu, which makes ordering simple, but it still feels like a very local spot. The prices are incredible for the quality. The rice noodles with pork and spring roll are absolutely amazing and ended up being my favorite meal of the entire trip. A must-try if you’re in the area!

author: Manuel Dresselmann
review_text:
We found this place on Google looking for foodplaces to be in the City. We almost passed the Shop since downstairs looks more like a garage for motorbikes than a Restaurant.

At a very small counter you order your mal which is either grillen pork, minced pork or springrolls in a combination with glass noodles and greens. You can also mix it for a combination of All 3 Extras. If you wish for more noodles additions are free.

After your order you can go upstairs, take a seat and wait for your order to arrive. The dining area is very minimalistic which gives the place a unique feel. The food is what it is all about. A whole 2 liter Bucket of "nuoc mam" the local fish sauce makes the dish. Its fresh, its well made and screams "umami".

We enjoyed it a lot.

author: Norbert
review_text:
AMAZING PLACE. The prices are totally local and the food is delicious. The staff is super nice, too.

Heads up for Europeans/Americans: I’d recommend ordering extra spring rolls or meat. The portions are 'Vietnamese style,' but honestly, even if you order 3 portions, the price is still low 😅. Highly recommend!! I came here 2 days in a row!

author: Fred Jaeger
review_text:
You have to order first and pay.
It was the best price value for you can get here.
I was a bit worried about the salad cleanliness tho. Let's see in a few days

Nuoc mam was good. Everything was good.
Sometimes you have bikes in here though because of delivery.

33k vnd for 1 bowl

author: Sarah C
review_text: Food was super affordable and delicious. Seating is upstairs and it can get quite hot in the Viet heat but that’s normal with no AC. The sauces were in a giant pail which was amazing, you could use as much as you wanted. The fresh leaves were amazing to eat with your main. 10/10 would come back. Cash only btw!

author: Angeline Ng
review_text:
Want a simple hearty meal with bbq pork and spring rolls. It’s certainly a local joint , for a moment u would think it’s a bike shop however the place has so many bike inside for Grab delivery collectors and Patrons to ride and dine. Seats are also available upstairs, so it's really nice and clean for just a quick Bún Thịt Nướng (Vietnamese Grilled Pork & Rice Noodles)
Cheap and good spot to come to for a quick meal. Will definitely come back

author: V. L. (VonMeetsWorld)
review_text:
I visited Kiều Bảo in October 2025.
The bowl of Bún Thịt Nướng from Kiều Bảo is a beautiful expression of Saigon’s everyday artistry — humble, balanced, and quietly confident.

The white rice noodles forming a soft cloud at the base; golden spring roll resting on one side; charred pork slices and grilled pork patties spread over the top; crushed peanuts scattered like tiny jewels; a small nest of pickled carrots and scallions providing color and bite.

The grilled pork — smoky, slightly caramelized, with visible grill marks — carries that unmistakable aroma of lemongrass and fish sauce that instantly awakens your appetite. Each bite has that sweet–savory contrast the Vietnamese have perfected: first the gentle crunch of the seared surface, then the tender, juicy meat that almost melts.

Then there’s the chả giò — the fried spring roll — crisp and golden on the outside, shattering audibly with the first bite.

The basket of lettuce and cucumber is crisp and cool, almost dewy, cutting through the richness of the meat. When you tear the greens with your fingers and fold them into the bowl, they bring everything to life — suddenly, the dish feels lighter, brighter, and more alive.

Finally, when you pour over the nước chấm (fish sauce dressing), the whole bowl transforms.

For my full review, do check out my video diary in my YouTube Channel!

author: Jesus Estrada
review_text: Tried a few days ago for a late lunch but they were out of spring rolls so I left and came back. The first time, the register lady was dismissive. This time, the register lady was kind. The staff are helpful. There is a menu with pictures and English descriptions. The price is really affordable. The meal was really good. The minced pork was ok, and the grilled pork was great, if not a little dry. The spring rolls are on the small side but crispy and tasted pretty good. One bite had an off flavor, but the rest of everything was very tasty. Paid in cash. Will return.

author: Hà Minh Dũng
review_text: super affordable and good value for money. staff super nice n cute. thats why they full all the time. taste is good compare to price. order a full bowl will cost roughly 1.5 usd. with first free refill of veggie and rice noodle. this restaurant is super cool in this area

author: Julie Xiao
review_text: I came after being recommended by a local.   You order at the cashier downstairs and they deliver your order to your table upstairs. This place specializes in bún thịt nướng which is grilled pork served over vermicelli noodles with fresh herbs, vegetables, and fish sauce. I like that they give you a bucket (yes, a literal bucket) of nước chấm (fish sauce). It's super affordable ($1) and it's very filling especially if you get two spring rolls. I would definitely recommend!

author: Chi Pham
review_text: This place was introduced to me as a popular tourist spot, so it was understandably quite busy. The ordering process was a bit confusing ay first - you have to order and pay at the counter, then choose a seat and wait for someone to collect your receipt and prepare your food. The process could definitely be streamlined. Service and hygiene weren’t the best, but I’d still recommend it as a fairly healthy, reasonably priced and light meal option.

author: Wasurat Niyomrat
review_text: This restaurant doesn’t have a huge menu, but it serves simple Vietnamese dishes that are incredibly delicious no matter how they’re prepared. The fresh vegetables are refillable for free, which I really appreciated. I wish they had a branch in Thailand! In conclusion, I highly recommend this place. 🧡🧡🧡

author: Nicholas Lim
review_text:
This place deserves more than Michelin Guide. Superb food at unbelievable prices. Spring rolls are insanely good (spring rolls > grilled pork). You must try this place if you are in Saigon. The locals absolutely love this place and the prices are just too cheap for such a heavenly bowl of perfection. Each bowl comes with a hearty amount of greens and the big bucket of fish sauce is at your disposal. Add however much to your liking.

1) Order your meal at the counter
2) Pay with cash only and receive a receipt for your order
3) Pass the receipt to the kitchen for your meal
4) Sit back at your table and wait to be served

author: Deon Jong
review_text:
A must try in HCM.
Local restaurant with delicious spring roll with grilled meat. Pairedwith vermicelli and crush peanuts for additional texture. Pour some house made fish sauce concoction into your meal and enjoy!

author: Cong He
review_text: We were recommended this spot from our tour guide and its a definite must visit, local vibes with many bike delivery drivers able to ride their bikes into the store to pick up orders. The food was out fast and fresh, the signature BBQ rice noodles were delicious, it had a good portion and the spring roles were cripsy with a generous filling

author: Dana Kizer
review_text: One of our favorite restaurants on our visit to Saigon. The menu is limited but the food is delicious! This is the closest dish to what Americans call vermicelli in the states. A tour guide recommended this restaurant and it did not disappoint. It is extremely casual but the food is excellent. You order at the counter and pay, they give you a sign to put on your table, an employee will get your receipt from you at the table and then bring the food to you. Remember to use this fish sauce. There is a large bucket on each table with small bowls for you to scoop it into. There are also diced peppers on the table to add to it if you like it spicy.

author: Rene Shin
review_text: I think these foods at this price would be perfect for everything. It was really delicious.

author: Carl Shi
review_text:
Great local casual food shop, friendly and helpful staff. The location is in a narrow and very busy street. the BBQ sausage(minced pork) and BBQ pork pieces are quite tasty.  The rice noodles are fresh, the bucket of pre-made fish sauce are just season to taste. Free refill rice noodles which is good for big eaters.
For 30,000 Dung is an absolute bargain! Worth to go and have one.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: SERA RUTH
review_text:
If you're craving authentic Korean cuisine in Ho Chi Minh, look no further than Doran Doran. This charming spot offers a clean and welcoming atmosphere, making it an excellent choice for lunch or dinner. The restaurant is not overly noisy, providing a peaceful and relaxing dining experience.

One standout feature is the precision of their lunch sets, which are well-balanced and satisfying. You’ll get a good variety of dishes that reflect true Korean flavors. The portions are generous and well thought out, perfect for anyone looking to enjoy a fulfilling meal without feeling overwhelmed.

What truly adds to the experience is the hospitality — the boss, a kind Korean person, oversees the restaurant, ensuring everything runs smoothly and guests feel at home. The staff is friendly and attentive, adding to the welcoming vibe of the place.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Sebastian Estores
review_text:
This was soooooo good. Every bonchon was perfect, the bibimbap comes in a hot stone, and everything tastes how it should. No shortcuts in any of the foods they prepared.

I recommend going with many people, as even the lunch set was a LOT of food. The cinnamon dessert was also a really interesting experience.

I could go on and on but just try it. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Jamie Newell
review_text: Super tasty food for a reasonable price. 8 side dishes offered complimentary with the main. Would highly recommend coming!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Huỳnh Lê Thiên Ý
review_text: The atmosphere is super laid-back, and the food is absolutely tasty! Plus, there are endless refills of yummy banchan and free ice cream to enjoy.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Anais Lim
review_text: From the guidance to the seating after entering to the free ice cream dessert at the end, all the food was good. We especially enjoyed the galbi seafood stew. The side dishes were seasoned just right, it was clean, and the staff was friendly, so I had a pleasant dinner.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Võ Ngọc May Thảo
review_text:
Good place to have great time with friends. Korean food is good, perfect service. The owner is really nice and supportive. You will want to return.
Picture is when we finished all. Nothing left.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Philip Hoang
review_text: Love this restaurant. The food is amazing and value for money. They even have free ice cream at the end of the meal, but we were already so full. Also our waiter Nhat Huy was amazing. My mum twisted her ankle earlier in the evening and he was so great and gave us a make shift ice pack so my mum could put it on her ankle. Would recommend this restaurant to anyone.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Oisín Dolan
review_text:
Extremely friendly place. Great food and selection with combos that let you get a few different things to taste. Would be brilliant for a group

Try the cinnamon tea. Never had it before and it's such a nice refreshing sweet end to a meal that won't leave you feeling full

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Michael Ruhwedel
review_text:
We had a fantastic Bibimbap.
The rice was crispy from the hot bowl. Vegetables fresh with very tasty mushrooms. The egg cooked to perfection.
It was the best Bibimbap I had ever eaten.
The appetizers were diverse and very flavorful. The kimchi tasted spicy and extraordinarily well.
The staff provided impeccable service. They were attentive and proud of their restaurant. We were gifted a cold bean sprout soup and mochi ice cream. This left us refreshed and with a feeling of having been very lucky to have found this place.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: YONGJUN SONG (JUN)
review_text: I recently visited this Korean restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, and it was a great experience! The food tasted just like home — especially the kimchi stew and bulgogi, which were both delicious and full of flavor. The staff were friendly and attentive, and the place had a cozy, welcoming vibe. I’ll definitely come back again. Highly recommend if you’re craving authentic Korean food in Vietnam!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Thuy Ly
review_text: One of the best place for cold noodle and bbq in Saigon. I cam here 3 years ago and this time the flavor is still the same 🥰

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Yoon Sung_YS Kim, (YS)
review_text:
Korean restaurant owned and managed by Vietnamese.
1. The taste and services were good enough.
2. The price was reasonable.
3. The location is a bit 애매하다

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Ali Taghipour
review_text:
I went for a combo for two at this Korean restaurant, and as I’m writing this review, I’m about to burst! 😂
It’s a 3-course meal with tons of side dishes—easily enough for three people.

From the mouthwatering BBQ to bibimbap and kimchi, everything was fresh, flavorful, and top-notch. 🌶️😋
Portions are huge, and even if you’re not that hungry, you’ll keep eating because it’s just that good!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Quyen Nguyen
review_text:
It is not close to authentic Korean food yet, we ordered 3 dishes, gimbap, kimchi fried rice, and tteokbokki, total 500k vnd.
-I have nothing to say about the gimbap (8/10)
-The kimchi fried rice is bland and needs more kimchi taste in it. Also it looks nothing like the picture on the menu! (6/10)
-For tteokbokki (6.5/10), the rice cake was overcooked and was too soft. The rice cake needs to be a bit more chewy. The fish cake, on the other hand, needs to be cooked a bit longer..... I had to wait until the tteokbokki got cold for the texture to become better.

I ordered kimchi fried rice and asked them to add no pork in it but they added pork sausage so it took them another 15 minutes to remake it for us, other than that the service and atmosphere were good .
The ginger tea at the end was refreshing 😁

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Vy Duong
review_text:
Best dishes recommendation since we always go back for them
- Grilled cheese
- Kimchi Pork Belly Sauteed with Tofu
- Seafood Pancake
- and the grilled meats…. AMAZINGG!!!!
- Free ice cream 💯
Great service and good for friends gathering since one portion is quite a lot.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Dung Tran
review_text: Tasty food. Big portions. Good vibes. The owner is so sweet! Had a great lunch here. Would definitely come again!

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Ms Gift
review_text: The food I got was delicious. As someone who never takes back food to my hotel room when traveling, this is my first taking my remaining food back to my room because I couldn’t finish it. The server and the manager were very attentive and helpful. Would definitely come back💯

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Tôm
review_text: This is a great place if u wanna try original-flavored korrean dishes! I suggest that u should have 1 bowl per 2 pp if u can't eat much^^ (I rlly love the banchan here, they refill almost instantly)

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Felicia Samin
review_text: The food here taste similar to actual Korean food. We especially love the pajeon.

restaurant: Nhà Hàng Hàn Quốc DORAN DORAN
author: Vân Lê
review_text:
we came with 2 for lunch and ordered jajangmeon, steamed egg, kimchi soup and grilled belly pork, total bill was ab 600, quite good price for a Korean cuisine restaurant in D1 district

quite big portion of the jajang, and it's on promotion 99k any noodle (it's 150k on menu)

good and well served food even the panchan; free ice-cream after meal

clean and nice restaurant, helpful staff and an active owner, I guessed, was there to help, offer the ice cream, asking for feedback,...

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Alice Wang
review_text:
I went here 3 times with my friends, want to introduce them about Vietnamese vegan foods.Foods was good but pineapple fried rice didn't have any smal pieces of pineapple, too dried.
Dink was great and always surprised me.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Michael Phạm
review_text:
We had such a great experience dining at Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ! The food was delicious—fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. We were lucky enough to visit during a special event, so we got to try some new creations that were absolutely amazing. It felt like a real treat.

The atmosphere was calm, elegant, and welcoming—perfect for relaxing and enjoying good food with great company.

The only small downside was that the table was a bit tight for our group of 10, but honestly, everything else made up for it. The food and experience were more than worth it.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Mona
review_text: Delicious vegetarian restaurant with a cozy atmosphere and friendly staff. Quiet and clean. Recommend it!

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Antoni Carrascal
review_text: A perfect restaurant to take photos and post on social media. In terms of quality, honestly, nothing that makes me say ‘wow, I have to save this place in my agenda.’ Service… to be honest, they make you feel like an alien. You speak to them in English and they give you a look of denial. You speak Vietnamese and their face is the same, so it’s better not to talk about the service. So, in summary… if your goal is to take photos, it’s a good place; if, on the other hand, it’s to eat… that’s up to you.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Khang Le
review_text:
Our first time dining here during lunch! Ordered plenty of food for 2! And the menu was fantastic
Great choices! Servers was very knowledgeable. The interior design is another level. Super relaxing atmosphere. Everything is Buddhist inspiration. All the small details was perfect.

Now talk about the food! Menu has a great choices of vegan food. Their dessert and drinks is also amazing. Must try their SUSHI / NIGIRI OPTION! (Its also vegan / no finish)

Will definitely coming back with friends and family. And totally recommended restaurant

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Thanh Ngan Nguyen Tran
review_text: I had a wonderful experience at this place with my friend! Every dish was fresh, flavorful and beautifully presented. The staff were so kind and welcoming, which made the whole atmosphere even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!!!

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Sky Grace
review_text: This place is absolute phenomenal. It has amazing vegan sushi so authentic and delicious and healthy. We had such a phenomenal time here this is probably one of the most amazing authentic vegan sushi places I’ve been to in my life. Only recommendation is not to use mothballs in the bathroom, they make some of us very nauseous.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Tien T. Tram
review_text: good food, great service. The staff (Hien) was so helpful and friendly

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: My Tran
review_text:
A must-visit for anyone who loves great food — vegan or not.
The dishes here are fresh, flavorful, and made with real care. Everything tastes as good as it looks, and you leave feeling nourished and satisfied. The staff are warm, the vibe is calm, and the whole experience feels thoughtful and welcoming. I’ll definitely be coming back!

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Frog Green
review_text: The food was delicious, sushi was perfect and tasted like the real deal! Drinks were beautiful and tasted refreshing and sweet. The pizza was filled with toppings, it was yummy only thing is that the crust n dough is a bit stiff..not the ones like pizzahut/domino but overall it was amazing for a vegetarian dish. The service was great, they were very kind and sweet. The sushi is overall worth the price, I'd definitely come back again and try more sushi and other dishes.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Bredgy L.
review_text:
Follow @bredgyeats for more food posts!

Mindblowing. That’s how I would describe my elevated dining experience at this beautiful vegetarian restaurant, reserved for the finale. The star of the show and the source of my wet dreams: Durian Curry. My newfound love that borders on yandere obsession, where creamy coconut milk meets durian in a swirl of sweetness, funk and richness that lingers on your tongue. Thai basil lifts it with an herbaceous perfume, cauliflower and dense mushrooms give chew and bounce, while slices of crusty yet fluffy baguette beg to be dragged through every last drop. Backtracking, the mushroom salad brings a riot of textures all in one: bouncy oyster mushrooms and meaty lion's mane play against the crunch of peanuts and carrots, while starfruit and Thai basil cut in with brightness. The fried mushrooms add a nutty depth, and the whole thing feels alive once dressed with the tangy-sweet umami-filled fish sauce. How they achieve such delicious meatballs without meat is beyond me, when such convincing golden-crumbed spheres deliver a fragrant crunch, giving way to a moist legume filling that mimics ground meat. The fermented soybean sauce layers on a funky depth, and the mango salads bring a fruity spark. Finally, it's decorated with a glint of edible gold leaf and a fog of dry ice to drive the spectacle.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Thanh Nguyen
review_text: The place is peaceful and suitable for family. We could buy discounted buffet by buying online vouchers through fanpage. The staff are nice, friendly, and supportive. The food is varied and worth for money.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: sofia
review_text: AMAZING FOOD AND EXPERIENCE!! We got the combo spring rolls, soba noodles, pineapple fried rice, lions mane with ginger and Thai teas and it was all delicious 10/10 ! The highlight were definitely the combo rolls and the lions mane with ginger! Come here if you are vegetarian, you won’t regret it :)

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Amy Huynh
review_text: We walked into this restaurant it really knowing what to expect.  To our surprise the food is really delicious.  We ordered a few dishes to share and our waitress Nhung gave some excellent recommendations.  Every dishes we had was very good.  The restaurant was quiet and calm, really fit the theme.  Definitely recommend trying.   Nhung was our sever and she did a great job!

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Amanda Luu
review_text: Great atmosphere and dining experience. Presentation was unique and all the dishes were fantastic. Staff were attentive and friendly. The signature drink is fun, but aside from it being pretty, is actually quite refreshing and not too sweet. I’ll be back to try more dishes. Highly recommend!

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Jane Le
review_text:
Came in during weekend, the place not very crowded but serve a bit slow. Ordered curry and the food came with cool temperature.
Will not come back.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Kelly Wing
review_text: Food overall is quite good, nice decoration, privately. However, in my opinion, the staff was unprofessional because that was my birthday, me and my friend has come first then the staff just asked there would a birthday cake, would us like to use right away. I think this is a big mistake and I feel a bit bad. I hope the restaurant will look again about the first impression from your staff.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Zeeb M.
review_text: A sensational experience in every way, lots of variety and 100% vegan, an unforgettable bistro.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Friederike Voß
review_text: If you are a vegetarian or vegan, this place is for you! I loved the food and the service is great! I recommend coming here with friends or family and order a lot of dishes to share with everyone. My favorite was the lotus salad, but I'm sure you will love anything here.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Julie M
review_text:
Lovely place.
beautifully presented food and great choices for vegetarians. Loved the little donuts, they were soft and delicious

author: Martino Avallone
review_text:
Alright, after three weeks in Vietnam and several Banh Mi  eaten along the way, I can say that this one was the absolute best.
Out of curiosity, I ordered also a rice stew banana leaves which was extremely tasty. The rice pudding was filled with mince meat that reminded me a bolognese ragù. The meat was super tasty and perfectly cooked, with visible Maynard reaction spot on. Quail eggs inside were good and gave a nice touch to the overall   plate.

The banh mi was incredibly good. Let’s start by saying that all the ingredients were top quality. Fresh and tasty. The bread was crunchy like if it came out of the oven 5 mins before. The meat was really good and all the different pieces were well balanced together. The vegetables were also fresh.

If you wanna taste the best Banh Mi, I highly recommend this one here.
Let me know what you think about it.

author: Jessie Lan Pham
review_text:
I used to notice that the shop charged extra for takeaway boxes and for cutting the banh mi in half, but those fees are now waived. This willingness to listen to customer feedback is truly commendable.

I ordered the banh mi with char siu pork, pâté, butter, and pork floss, meaning there was no cold cuts or Vietnamese ham. Personally, I prefer this version as it feels lighter and less greasy. Since I ordered quite early, the pickles only included white daikon, but the shop was generous with scallions. A nice detail is that their scallions are not pungent at all. There were fewer cucumbers and chilies, but overall the vegetables and pickles were fresh.

Overall, the banh mi was flavorful and generously filled. The char siu pork was well balanced, neither too fatty nor too lean and dry. The portion size is not overly large, but it is satisfying enough that even hearty eaters can easily finish one whole sandwich.

author: Will Noble
review_text: A super full and meaty Banh Mi! The butter ratio that is used is quite frankly ludicrous! In a good way. The filling is so good and really makes for a delicious sarnie. I went twice after a local friend took me here and then I came back again because it was such a good first experience. Both times I sat in the air conditioned seating area and I liked how they gave you plenty of wipes. Great spot!

author: Nicholas Hugh Sam
review_text:
i understand the other raving reviews, but i prefer my banh mis less full.

the price to food ratio is unmatched, super cheap, very flavourful and big banh mi, but it's really too much for me.

too much butter, too much meat. you can't really taste the individual ingredients anymore.

i understand, but not for me.

their juices are FANTASTIC though.

author: Manuel Dresselmann
review_text:
The Shop got our attention after seeing an incredibly long queue that went on for ages. Every morning. It just had to be great, we thought.

Luckily for us, the long queue in the morning is pretty much all delivery drivers so we were able to order right next to them immediately.

You have a choice between a banh mi or s special banh mi. Lets be honest, who would even consider not going special. We chose the small version and took a seat inside. The food arrived before we could sit down. Incredibly fast. You get many side ingredients like pickles, Chili, cilantro & chives.

Although supposedly small we barely finished it. The sandwhich was packed to the brim. Whatever you expect in a banh mi volume wise, double it. So flavourfull and filling. A great place to start your day.

author: Hungry Two Travel
review_text: We were recommended this spot from a local we got chatting to. We’re really glad we ended up checking them out! Their banh mi is absolutely massive, packed with meat, pate and butter. Seriously one of the biggest banh mi in Saigon and definitely worth checking out. 75K VND for one. Check out our channel for a full review of our experience: Hungry Two Travel.

author: vu nguyen
review_text: This place is situated just outside Bui vien walking street and is a very busy and popular shop. For such a small spot they do churn out a large some of food. I had the banh mi nem thit nuong, which was packed with meat with generous portions of pate and butter. I also ordered some banh day, which is essentially steamed mochi as the carb portion of the sandwich and steamed pork. This thing was one of my favorite things to eat growing up in the states.

author: Mike
review_text:
I really like the presentation, staff were polite, and courteous. Ordered the special, and salted cream coffee.
Overall not a bad banh mi, and you get what you pay for. These bad boys come stuffed, but my gripe is that all the meat and pâté lacked seasoning, and too much butter muted the flavors of the different cuts for my taste.
My favorite is the salted cream coffee, so delicious.

author: Shantelle
review_text: Found a hair in the salad unfortunately. Gave it to a staff member - not sure if they misunderstood but the same container was brought back to me, still with the hair in it. Sent it back again and was given a replacement container. The banh mi itself was a big serving size with generous fillings. Good flavours but the pate was a bit overpowering for my liking.

author: trinisha nguyen
review_text: great banh mi dac biet. lots of bo and pate if u like that! i only got one pickled carrot in my bag which was a little sad but ok. very filling and yummy!

author: Andy
review_text: I think this was the BEST sandwich of my life! they only have two options, which means they’re the best at it. It was sooo good, I had to order another 3 for my flight home. I wish they had a spot in every country. Unfortunately I don’t have photos of the actual meal, because I was busy eating them 1000/10

author: Ishel lao
review_text: Ordered their special bread in small size, but it was already filling and satisfying to the heart’s content! 🥖✨ Banh Mi is flavorful and hearty, service is great, and they even have a cozy space to enjoy your sandwich with refreshing fruit drinks. Definitely worth a visit!

author: Ann Ng
review_text:
Bánh mì Bà Huỳnh (Madam Win) is quite a famous bánh mì shop in Saigon, always busy with both delivery drivers and walk-in customers.

🥖 The baguette is crispy on the outside and soft inside, with generous fillings — rich and flavorful meat, fresh cucumber, herbs, and pickled vegetables. It’s very filling, and the portion is so big that one person might not even be able to finish it!
🥬 My only small drawback is that the pickled vegetables are on the sweet side. Personally, I prefer them more sour as it helps cut through the richness.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 After dining in, we also ordered a couple more to take away for the family, and everyone was satisfied.

📦 I was pleasantly surprised by the takeaway packaging. Instead of just paper bags, they use proper boxes, and even separate the herbs and pickled vegetables individually — very neat, clean, and thoughtful.

💰 Small size is 50,000 VND, big size is 75,000 VND. Considering the District 1 location, portion, and packaging, I think the price is reasonable.

Overall, it’s a very good bánh mì experience. Definitely worth trying if you’re nearby! 🍞🌿🥒

author: Xing Ying
review_text:
ordered on grab food cos i needed a early morning breakfast.

special bahn mi in large - shared for 2 pax and the portion was really really big. i could not finish it despite sharing. bun was really crispy and the filling was generous.

would recommend!

author: Phasoka Khiev
review_text: A big banh mi filled with good stuff. The bread is so crunchy and the fillings come with variety of deliciousness. One Banh mi can keep me full almost the whole day. Yummy 😋 It’s my 2nd time here, will come back more.

author: Blake
review_text: Don't expect a sophisticated bahn mi, expect a fresh simple ingredients bahn mi with a good balance of flavour. I'll happily visit again.

author: James Prince
review_text: The best Banh Mi in town! Only two selections and everything’s is made in advance so no wait! The bun is soft and crispy. The filling is so moorish and delicious - and they slather a good chunk of ghee in the centre to bind it all together. We ate right there in front of the kitchen in the rain amongst all the traffic chaos - great experience. Most seem to order on grab because of the location on a busy road.

author: YMC
review_text: Stopped by Bánh Mì Bà Huỳnh and it hit the spot. Fresh veggies, great flavor, and super clean packaging. Worth the stop if you’re craving real Vietnamese bánh mì.

author: Aimee Nessling
review_text: I had the special bánh mì here and it was absolutely amazing! The bread was perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and the fillings were so fresh, flavorful, and generous. Every bite had the perfect balance of savory meats, fresh herbs, and that delicious homemade sauce. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the shop had a really local, authentic vibe. Easily one of the best bánh mì experiences I’ve had in Ho Chi Minh, highly recommend stopping by if you want a true taste of Vietnam!

author: Ben S
review_text:
The worst bánh mì I’ve had so far in Vietnam. Seriously terrible. I don’t know why it’s so popular.

I tried two sandwiches: the grilled pork and the special bánh mì.

The grilled pork wasn’t real grilled pork chop—it was more like hot dog meat. Nasty. I wanted actual grilled pork, not filler.

The special bánh mì was full of cured meats that just tasted like preservatives. No good flavor—just salty, fake, and unhealthy.

The bread was way too toasted, so hard it cut the roof of my mouth. It also didn’t seem freshly toasted—the sandwich was room temperature and the meat inside was cold.

The mayo spread tasted weird and looked too yellow, which made me think it wasn’t fresh.

The price was also very high. Almost 100,000 VND for the special bánh mì.

Also the staff didn't care at all when I told them I didn't realize the grilled pork banh mi was not real meat. They basically said too bad, you paid for it.

author: Yelo JC
review_text:
Excellent experience at Cơm Niêu Chú Chen! 🌟
The Vietnamese food here is simply spectacular: authentic, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. The rice cooked in a clay pot is a delight, and watching it being served is a truly memorable experience. The dishes are beautifully presented, and the portions are generous.

The atmosphere is cozy and charming, ideal for a quiet meal or a meal with friends. The staff is very friendly, always smiling, and willing to explain the dishes or offer recommendations.

Without a doubt, one of the best Vietnamese restaurants in the heart of Quận 1. I will definitely be back! 🇻🇳✨

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: CP-AT Pham-Tran
review_text: Located right in the city center, the restaurant is clean, has a diverse menu, and reasonable prices.

author: Phung Nguyen
review_text: Today, my family and I went to eat Com Nieu. I chose Com Nieu Chu Chen on Nguyen Trai street because there was a parking lot. My family went in a large group and ordered many dishes, but surprisingly, every dish was delicious. Especially braised snakehead fish with pork belly and sour soup were also delicious. The restaurant is quite crowded at noon, so I think you should reserve a table and order food in advance for quick service. My family ordered the dishes in advance, so we arrived and sat for about 10 minutes before the dishes were served. The tofu pudding for dessert was surprisingly delicious. The total cost for the meal was only 160k per person including drinks. Overall, it was delicious, my family will come back.

author: Khánh Tâm
review_text:
The claypot rice and food here are delicious 😍,

I rarely eat claypot rice, my friend is abroad so I want to let her experience Vietnamese cuisine.
I opened the map and saw this restaurant, the picture was also very interesting so I took my friend to eat and the ending was very surprising, it was delicious, very delicious 🤤 !

We ordered:
- normal claypot rice
- burnt edge claypot rice (quite painful to the teeth, don't recommend eating 🥲)
- stir-fried morning glory with garlic (crazy delicious!)
- bitter melon fish cake soup (delicious, but the fish cake is not too fragrant 😢)
- lemongrass chicken (delicious, my friend loves this dish)

My friend paid so I don't remember how much the damage was 🤣🤣🤣, remember it was delicious haha

author: Vien Nguyen
review_text:
The rice tastes like home-cooked rice, the seasoning is just right for the taste, my family ate a combo of 4 people and the bill was less than 500k. Too cheap compared to similar restaurants and the location is in the center of District 1
Will come back

author: Ngoc Tram
review_text: My family and I ordered the Com Nieu combo for 10 people. The food is delicious and of good quality but the price is very cheap. The Kho Quet is very delicious, everyone. Being in the center of District 1 like this is great. Convenient parking on Nguyen Cu Trinh street, the restaurant has 2 street fronts.

author: Hoàng Thu Linh
review_text: The braised pork with pepper was mostly fat, but the other dishes were well-seasoned. So I'll give it 4 stars.

author: Tony Channel
review_text: The rice here is near my company. Delicious and clean. Overall, thank you for the location in District 1.

author: Nghi Thuyết
review_text:
The claypot rice here in District 1 is delicious. Clean, reasonable price
Seasoned according to Northern taste, not too sweet
Big restaurant with 2 fronts, comfortable parking, will come back to support long term

author: Thanh Mai
review_text: Com Nieu is located right in the center of District 1, has parking, airy, diverse dishes, suitable for taste, delicious. Fast service, will introduce to friends and come back.

author: Man Phan
review_text: The claypot rice here is delicious. I think this is the best place in District 1. Office workers eat a lot. Parking is convenient.

author: Thanh Lam
review_text: Delicious claypot rice, variety of dishes, delicious shrimp paste dish worth trying, parking on both sides, will come back

author: Châu Nguyễn Hoàng
review_text: This restaurant is fantastic! The food is perfectly seasoned, the ingredients are fresh, and the service is very quick. The space is clean and airy, creating a comfortable feeling like eating at home. The staff are friendly and welcoming, making me want to come back many more times.

author: Toan la vinh
review_text: Delicious Claypot Rice. Especially the special dish of black chicken stewed with coconut.

author: Thảo Nguyễn Phương
review_text: The rice in the clay pot was delicious, the dishes were flavorful, the portion of braised fish was a bit small, but the braised pork belly was very tasty – everyone seemed to be ordering it :>>

author: Hieu Chi
review_text: The restaurant was cool and comfortable. It was very crowded when we arrived, but the staff served us very quickly. The food was served a little slowly, probably because it was busy that day, but the food was delicious and high-quality, so I'll give it 5 stars as a token of appreciation for the staff and chefs!

author: na ah
review_text: The restaurant is located right in the heart of District 1, but the prices are reasonable, the food is delicious, and it suits my family's taste perfectly. I'll definitely bring my family back to eat there sometime.

author: Hoàng Khánh Linh Nguyễn
review_text: This is truly the claypot rice restaurant that I feel most satisfied with in District 1. The claypot rice restaurant has delicious Northern flavor, suitable for the taste, the golden crispy rice layer, fragrant served with rich traditional dishes. Lunch here is delicious, the menu is diverse with many dishes, 2 people ate until full and still did not run out of rice. The restaurant space is clean, has convenient parking, very suitable for office workers or families, the price is reasonable, I will definitely come back here many more times.

author: Duong Van Hieu
review_text: The rice was cold, the customer asked to change to another pot and it burned. Overall, not as advertised.

author: Thị Thương Nguyễn
review_text: Bringing family from the countryside to eat is also quite delicious, love boiled meat with shrimp paste, delicious and clean, will come back to this claypot rice restaurant in District 1

author: MsOmNom
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Authentic pho, Michelin-recognised for a reason

Visited Phở Hùng near Ben Thanh Market in Ho Chi Minh City, and it absolutely lived up to its Michelin Guide recognition (2024–2025).

This is a no-frills, very local spot serving excellent, authentic pho at very reasonable prices. The atmosphere feels genuinely Vietnamese — simple, bustling, and focused on the food.

I tried the house special pho, and it was outstanding. The broth was deep, aromatic, and clean, with generous portions of beef and well-balanced flavours. Add in the fresh herbs, bean sprouts, and chilli to taste, and it’s comfort food at its best.

To top it off, they also serve traditional Vietnamese iced coffee, which was strong, smooth, and the perfect finish to the meal.

If you’re looking for a true local pho experience in Ho Chi Minh City — especially one backed by Michelin — Phở Hùng is absolutely worth a visit.

author: Chriz Shop
review_text:
If you ever come to Ho Chi Minh City, I really hope you give this beef noodle shop a chance. It’s located in District 1, so it’s very convenient to visit.
The pricing is reasonable and the portions are generous. The soup base is clear yet flavorful, with a light sweetness and a very comforting aroma. The noodles are smooth with a slightly rough texture, which gives them a nice chewy bite.
One great bonus is that the side vegetables are free-flow, so you can add as much as you like. I highly recommend the fat beef brisket. Don’t worry about the word “fat” — it’s definitely worth trying. The meat is soft and chewy, and surprisingly not oily or greasy at all.
Overall, it’s a satisfying and hearty bowl of beef noodles. If you’re in District 1, why not give it a try? 👍

author: Anupong Wongkulluck
review_text: Big and famous Pho restaurant with mostly visited by locals. Soup in chicken and beef Pho are different but both are tasty. The chicken meat is quite dried and chewy. Beef and meat ball are delicious. If you have to pick chicken or beef, just go for beef. For the price it is not expensive but you have to pay a little bit higher than small local restaurants.

author: 주영우
review_text: It was not very special, but it is delicious enought to try beef brisket noodle. They have quite much of quantity inside the bowl. It was good enough to win the hangover. Try the noodle with the fried bread. If I have chance to visit here again, I will do it. And I can introduce here to my friends too.

author: Retty Chheang
review_text: I had the all kinds of beef phô and it was great. The service is good and staffs are friendly and helpful. They don't speak English but speak enough just to take the order. I didn't realize their Michelin stars until I left.

author: Inspired by the Sun
review_text: It's probably the most flavoursome pho I've had in Vietnam. You can add as many greens to your soup as you wish. The broth really has depth. It's a local place but caters nicely to foreigners. The beef was ample and was really tasty. The beef at many other places is just bland.

author: Tunisia Ellis
review_text: The service was great. They provide vegetarian option as well. Very fast service.. and flavourful. The watermelon juice is super refreshing. My mom likes her meat well done and the staff were super nice and accommodating. They allowed us to place our luggage while we ate. Thank you so much Cam on :)

author: Christopher Gallacher
review_text: The Pho was amazing so flavoursome and lots to add at your own choices. The staff were great and the lay out was good. All in great place. I had a mixed meat and it was great I also had an iced tea and dough sticks (quãy) would definitely go back.

author: vu nguyen
review_text: Michelin recommended pho spot in d1 in Saigon. Lots of iterations of pho and a extensive beverage selection

author: The MY World
review_text: It's Phở restaurant, which was selected as "Selected" by Michelin. Actually I visited here long time ago but I cannot remember how they were, so I tried again. When I visited this time, it was rainning so not so many customers were coming. Then I had Pho Tap Cam (all in), then it came within a minute!! The fastest serving in Michelin Pho Lol. Anyway, The pho was quite standard and tastes good. Perfect as standard but not special. The price is a bit pricy due to Michelin. If you are looking for the The Standard Phở, then it's nice place to visit.

author: Hannah King
review_text: Very sweet family. They had many options of pho and other Vietnamese foods. Their many smoothie was also amazing.

author: Eizen Barleta
review_text: Went here on a friend’s recommendation. Everything was fresh, soothing for the throat, and full of flavor. It’s great that they’re open late, making it the perfect spot for satisfying your midnight cravings.

author: Simon S
review_text: Good portion sizes, soup is not oily and lots of meat in each bowl. The mango smoothie was also quite delicious. FYI they do not accept credit card here. They have a few English speaking staff to assist.

author: Elham Mohamed
review_text: Amazing spot! The food is super delicious. The broth is so deep and aromatic! The staff are very nice we went very late and  didn’t have cash on us, they offered to take us to an atm machine! Although they don’t speak much english they were very helpful showing us how to best enjoy the pho! The food is already a 10\10 and the hospitality makes it even 10000/10 It’s my first day here and I’m struggling not to eat here everyday.

author: RJ
review_text: Our first meal in Ho Chi Minh did not disappoint! From the generous serving of Beef Pho, unlimited veggies and friendly staff - everything was perfect

author: Daniel Khor
review_text: The pho is good and service is amazing too. Do come and try. The beef ball is awesome.

author: Chang Yu
review_text:
BEST PHO AND SERVICE EVER
