Love the soup and mango smoothie so much. The staffs were so friendly and supportive. They recommended their signature drink and asked me if I get any allergy or no dairy.

One time, I didn’t have enough money to afford it — I was short by about 2,000 dong. The staff was very kind and let me have it without paying the full amount. I felt grateful of their service. However, I still decided to come back the next day and pay the full price (don’t copy me, always bring cash guys). I highly recommend this restaurant you all

author: Eugene Zheng
review_text: The best bowl of pho at D1 in my opinion. Known more to the locals than to tourists. Be warned that Menu is in native vietnamese language. This place is best enjoyed if you have a local friend to show you how to have the full experience with the sauce and vegetables usage. Would also recommend that you get the fried dough sticks to try too. Very interesting.

author: Wai Wai
review_text:
Quick, Authentic, but Missing the Punch

We barely had time to settle in before our “large” pho hit the table—talk about fast service! If you're in a rush, this spot is perfect for a quick, satisfying slurp.

The pho comes with a generous helping of lime, bean sprouts, and herbs—definitely a nice touch. That said, the broth leaned on the milder side for me. I have had pho that tend to be more aromatic and herb-forward, I found myself missing that fragrant depth.

I ordered the mixed beef large bowl, but was a bit underwhelmed—only one piece of each meat type, which left the bowl feeling more noodle-heavy than expected. Still, the portion of noodles was fair, and the overall bowl warm and comforting.

The space itself feels authentic, clean
, with open fans circulating air and adding to the relaxed, street-side vibe. It’s not the most flavorful pho I’ve had, but for speed and simplicity, it definitely delivers.

Verdict: 3.5/5 ⭐️, could have definitely be a 4 if the pho was bigger in portion for the “large” size and more fragrant!

author: Chun Wong
review_text: Best pho in Vietnam! Friendly staff too, would definitely come back next time I'm back.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Chris C
review_text: We tried the bun bo hue for breakfast at 11am and it was amazing. The lady is very friendly and we loved the steak and flank beef spicy noodle soup for 70k. Great way to start the day.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Veronika Ulmanová
review_text:
We had such a good time at this vietnamese typical diner. Mainly, their pho is a must try! Delicious experience
Very friendly staff who offered an extra plate of sprouts when they only saw wee were enjoying it (without us even thinking of asking for more). They brought it to us with a kind smile. Hope their diner grows and goes well!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: James Eakins
review_text: I have come here for breakfast nearly every day of my trip and I love their three types of soup. The ladies are nice and lots of fans pointing at us to stay cool.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Vi Hoang
review_text: I tried Bun Moc here and it was a good experience. Meat's juicy and big, other pork pastes also good. Love the greens!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Gia Le
review_text:
Pros:
Tasty broth
Great location
Average portion
Cons:
Some of the meat (heart i think) was pretty tough.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: RS San
review_text: The hostess is very friendly, and the noodle soup is delicious!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Adrian Nguyen
review_text: Stepped into the store and nearly threw up because of the smell. Ordered Nam Vang and serving size was tiny compared to Nhan Quan competitor down the street. Prawns were definitely not fresh. Would not recommend here m. If you want hu tieu nam vang you need to go a store that specialises in it and not a place that sells alternate dishes as well.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Reardon
review_text: Had my first bun Bo hue here in southern vietnam. Excellent dish, tasty, fresh ingredients, and quiet if you sit inside. Open-aired giving you the feel of Vietnam. No English but that’s okay when you can point and choose. :)

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: 秋野雅人
review_text: 2019/1/20 I really love Hu Tieu. I went there in the afternoon when there weren't many customers, and I felt relaxed and at ease.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Chris Wong
review_text: It's been a long time since I've been to this restaurant. The Nam Vang noodles are still delicious. Today I took my mom and aunts to eat, and when the adults praised them, everyone knew it was a delicious restaurant. But there are 3 super picky mothers here. The noodles are rich, not salty and not chewy, suitable for the elderly. The meatballs are also ok, but the beef noodles are not something my family has had a chance to try yet. The restaurant is right at the front but the spice tray is very clean, not dusty. The 10k iced tea is huge, strong tea. Will come back!!!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Triet Le
review_text:
The restaurant seems to specialize in Nam Vang noodles.

My friend ordered dry Nam Vang noodles and it was delicious.

I ordered beef noodles, which were tasty but not very rich in the typical beef noodle flavor.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Cho Dongwook
review_text:
It was right next to my hotel, so I went there for breakfast.
I've been to Vietnam many times, and I don't think I've ever seen a place as cleanly maintained as this one.
The sauce containers are often dirty, but here, they were all cleaned, and they even provided saucers for each dish.
I ordered the dish pictured first on the menu, adding garlic, vegetables, and a little sauce. It was delicious.
I plan to return to this place on my next visit.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Alex Thuan
review_text: Hung Map's Phnom Penh-style noodle soup restaurant in District 1 is the ideal destination for those who love Phnom Penh-style noodle soup. The restaurant stands out with its rich flavor, delicious broth combined with shrimp, meat, and quail eggs, creating a fantastic bowl of noodle soup. The restaurant has a comfortable and clean atmosphere, and the service is quick and enthusiastic. What's special is that the prices here are very reasonable, suitable for many customers. If you are looking for a delicious and affordable restaurant in District 1, Hung Map's Phnom Penh-style noodle soup restaurant is a choice you shouldn't miss.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Vy Tường
review_text:
The space to sit outside is quite airy, prime location, the taste of the noodles is delicious and light, the shrimp and meat are fresh, the price of wet and dry noodles is 80k/bowl. 
The staff is cute, friendly, and there is a staff member who helps with parking.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: HUYEN NGUYEN
review_text:
It must be admitted that you get what you pay for. Although the price is quite high compared to many places, around 70,000-85,000 VND for a bowl like the one pictured, the taste is definitely different from other shops. The shop is located right at the intersection of Thai Binh market, easy to find.

The shop is clean and tidy, with a wide selection of fresh vegetables and various sauces to accompany different dishes, depending on your preference. The drink menu is quite diverse.

Overall, apart from the slightly high price, everything else is very good 👍

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Michel
review_text:
After visiting the Thai Binh market, I stopped at this restaurant for a meal.
The "Hu Tieu Nam Vang" noodle soup is very good with its broth.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Van Cao
review_text:
The noodle soup was delicious.
The beef noodle soup tasted a little too much MSG, but it was still good. The iced tea had a strong, bitter taste.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: 巴圖
review_text: The dry pho is delicious, the pig's feet are also soft and nice, the soup of the pho is great, but I don't know if Vietnamese pho soup is salty, but it is delicious.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Minh Bui
review_text: Food was better before. While I was eating, a mouse ran next to the table and started to grow whiskers.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Duyet Bui
review_text:
Bun moc ok, but buy to go
will come back to try other dishes, seems ok

author: Mark Gor
review_text: I recently dined at Hoang’s Kitchen in Ho Chi Minh City, and it was an absolute delight! The food was incredibly delicious – from the fresh spring rolls bursting with flavors to the tender grilled beef with rice, every bite was a perfect blend of authentic Vietnamese spices and freshness. What made the experience even better was our server, Anna. Her service attitude was impeccable; she was attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to recommend dishes that suited our tastes. Plus, Anna is absolutely stunning, adding a warm and welcoming vibe to the cozy atmosphere. Highly recommend this gem for anyone craving top-notch Vietnamese cuisine!

author: Dustin Kinzinger
review_text:
Review of Hoang's Kitchen, Ho Chi Minh City
ROSE 🌹

I recently dined at Hoang's Kitchen, where I was thoroughly impressed by the exceptional fried spring rolls – crispy, flavorful, and an absolute delight to eat. The warm and inviting atmosphere of the restaurant complemented the delicious food perfectly. A particular highlight of my visit was the outstanding service provided by our waitress, Rose. Her attentiveness and friendly demeanor really elevated our dining experience, making us feel valued and well-cared-for.

The staff at Hoang's Kitchen, especially Rose, truly made our meal special. Her recommendations were spot on, and her genuine kindness added to the restaurant's welcoming vibe. For anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City, I highly recommend stopping by Hoang's Kitchen for an unforgettable meal marked by delicious food and exceptional hospitality.

author: jurgita maciulskaite
review_text:
Amazing Service from Fish!

Had a great dining experience in District 1 thanks to our server, Fish. He was friendly, attentive, and gave perfect menu recommendations. His positive energy made the whole evening even better. Delicious food, great atmosphere, and truly outstanding service. Highly recommend asking for Fish!

author: R
review_text:
Dropped by around 3+ in the afternoon after seeing all the great reviews. The place was empty (well, duh look at the time sir), but the food definitely didn’t disappoint.

The beef rolled in wild betel leaves was the star of the meal for me. Rose was amazing too, recommending her favourite dishes and even showing us the proper way to enjoy the beef.

We ended the meal with two Saigon Specials, and honestly… that sealed the deal. One of the best meals we’ve had.

author: Rachel Green
review_text:
A great place to try or go for Viennese food. We found this place hidden away and pleased we took the chance.
Mai was a wonderful server from welcoming us and looking after us during our time.
The food was beautiful, tasty and a good variety.  I’d be happy to return here again.

author: Justin Rojas
review_text: Rose was great! Made me feel very welcome and showed how to do a proper rice paper wrap. Her English is very good also. This is a good spot for foreigners to come and try some northern Vietnamese food. They also supply you with plastic gloves if you want. The beers are also the lager size so are reasonably priced.

author: rose si
review_text: I really enjoyed the food here! The chicken pho and chicken spring rolls were super delicious, and the portion sizes were just perfect. We also had sweet potato fries, which were great too. I can highly recommend this place — the service was amazing, especially thanks to the staff member named Fish!

author: Angielou Timbang
review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience! Every dish we ordered was delicious, and the ambiance made it even more enjoyable. The staff were warm and attentive—especially our server, Fish. Highly recommended!

author: Liam Heron
review_text: The best pho and black pepper beef we have had on our trip around Vietnam. Food came out within minutes and was very fresh. Service from Anna was great. Price was very reasonable as well. Would highly recommend!

author: Ali Major
review_text:
Everything was delicious 😋 The best Vietnamese crispy pancake ever, and it is huge!
The book choy with shitake mushrooms was so good and the Hanoi rolls juicy and left over for breakfast!
Hats off to Fish for excellent service, he is an asset to the restaurant.

author: Kiran Hegde
review_text: The food was amazing. Fish was the person who served us. He was very kind and helpful and recommend a lot of dishes which was absolutely fabulous and delicious. Atmosphere was amazing. The staff were very polite. Would definitely recommend this place to all!!

author: Cheska Bantillo
review_text: Food is amazing!!! Fish is so helpful with all our requests. The atmosphere is good too. It feels nice to eat cause it’s peaceful and quiet. Will come back again 😍

author: Ryan Moran
review_text:
Wow amazing food !!! Rose was so kind and helpful- she made our trip to hoangs kitchen incredible! Overall its an adorable and an amazing place to eat - some of our favourite in Vietnam. PLEASE ORDER THE PANCAKE ! Its  amazing diy make food . Please take a visit so hoangs kitchen - you wont regret it!
By Meg

author: Viva M
review_text:
Excellent Vietnamese Food & Great Hospitality!
The food here was absolutely delicious — full of authentic Vietnamese flavours and generous in quantity. Every dish was fresh, aromatic, and perfectly balanced. Fish (nick name:)) was incredibly hospitable and made the whole experience even better with his warm and attentive service. Highly recommend this place if you want to enjoy the best of Vietnamese cuisine with great portions and friendly vibes!

author: Caitlin Lin
review_text: The food here is absolutely delicious. Definitely recommend the set #9 (Hanoi traditional fried fish), you will get to experience the fun of making the fresh roll by yourself! The service and people are also very nice.

author: just Wai
review_text:
Was served by Fish, he's very helpful.
I order vietnam pancake and grill pork. Portion is very big and taste really good. Worth the 5 stars.

author: Angelica Peñas
review_text:
Food was great! We ordered bun cha & the seafood pancake, which is a good breakfast if you want something that still feels fresh but heavy enough.
Thank you to Rose who served us well & even shared some Vietnam knowledge with us.
The egg coffee is a bit too salty for my taste, but still good.

author: Pradeep Mudaliar
review_text:
Food was Amazing. Thanks to the chef.
Service was immpecable. Anna was amazing. Her attention to detail has been great the whole time i was there. If i every come back to vietnam i will definately visit this place.
Thank you for your service Anna :)

author: ShaBen 2000
review_text:
Our waiter fish was the nicest guy ever. He was very thoughtful and ambotious to serve our needs.
Those onion-rings were the best ones we ever had. This place has a nice vibe, it is well cooled and the volume was very pleasant.

Thx for having us!🇩🇪🇻🇳

author: M Purdy
review_text: I’ve had Vietnamese food many times, but Hoang’s Kitchen definitely ranks as one of the best. We had summer shrimp rolls, fried rolls, beef pho and Vietnamese pancakes. Our server Nami explained all of the dishes and expertly showed us how to roll the Vietnamese pancakes. For dessert we had egg coffee (a must-try) and mango pancakes with coconut ice cream. If you find yourself in HCMC anytime soon, make sure to find your way to Hoang’s Kitchen!

author: Emilio
review_text:
I’m not really a soup person, so this review comes from that perspective.

The broth had a good flavor, and adding the fresh herbs and vegetables made it even better. The beef was good and the toppings were fresh.

The phở was enjoyable even for me, and the service was efficient and quick.

A very good experience overall.

author: Steve Hawkins
review_text:
Being visiting this place over the years, I think it has the best pho by far. The staff are always running around serving the multitudes and are friendly.
The serving size and other fresh side ingredients are always on point.
The atmosphere is ok, but you don't go there for atmosphere, it's the really nice pho. The seating area is always busy and sometimes you struggle to get a seat. But it won't take long and it's well worth a little wait. It placed on a corner so you can watch the world go by.
Definitely a must visit

author: Will Iam
review_text: Great place for authentic Vietnamese phở at any time of the day or night. Prices are super low and very affordable, especially considering the quality. The Phở Bò Kho is very tasty, rich in flavor, and well prepared. Being open 24/7 is a huge advantage, whether for an early breakfast or a late-night meal. Highly recommended if you are in the area.

author: Adam Fente
review_text:
I ate here almost everyday for a month during my time in HCM.

The environment is busy and so are the staff but the quality of the noodle soups are excellent.

I miss the Bo Kho which is the stewed beef dish in the photo, but the Pho Nam was my 2nd favorite dish here.

I miss this place and hope I can eat there again in the future in HCM ❤️

author: Victor
review_text: Had an amazing combination bowl for 89k. Super easy to order with a menu including English. Simple menu with food that comes super fast. Absolutely delicious with good portions. Amazing breakfast option.

author: Michael M
review_text: We landed late and wanted to eat pho.  Randomly stopped by and eat something warm. It’s now my favorite place to eat pho past 13:00. Delicious. Right amount of seasonings. Meatballs and raw beefs were soft every bite. Clear water. Fresh green veggies as a bit excessive. But I love and will come back.

author: Kong Wen Sheng
review_text: A very popular Pho shop that is located at the core of the street entering Bui Vien. From serving the community in the morning to serving tourists and part-goers at night, it’s positioned to fit all sorts of of customers. The flow comes in and out very quickly, but their beef is overcooked. Soup is decent but the beef didn’t pass on my standards, as it’s too stiff, either cut too thickly or overcooked, either way a no pass. To those who loves hard beef then this is recommended. To add on, coconut was old and has no flesh. Not much coconut juice too, meaning it’s not a fresh one.

author: Kisa Co
review_text: The Pho fulfilled my expectation, really delicious. Got a lot of veggie. The staffs were nice and so fast in serving. The price was great. For all of this was around 100Dong.

author: vu nguyen
review_text: 24 hour pho shop just on the outskirts of the walking street. Place was pretty packed at the time I went at 1030pm. Didn’t see anything exceptional about this place besides the convenience.

author: Casiopea
review_text: Loved the pho. Stew is darker as you are in south Vietnam. Pho delicious. Meat tender.

author: Philippa Pham Hughes
review_text: Not the best I ever ever had but good enough pho. A little too salty. A little expensive, too. But that’s to be expected given the location. Quaint space. Quick service. Had a fresh coconut to drink and that was delicious.

author: Alexander Brown
review_text: Would recommend the brisket pho over the beef. Very tasty - make sure to add the thai basil, hoisin sauce and chilli paste

author: Nisal
review_text:
Really good Pho. Tried the beef brisket and meatball pho here and really liked it. Beef stew was a bit hard though.
it's opened 24 hours as well.

author: Conrad
review_text: This place was really good 👍 100k for beef stew, greens, baguette and a beer. Sat on the intersection is a buzz of activity and scooters. The stew had tons of thick cut beef, soft and very tasty. What more can you ask for.

author: Sheen Utlang
review_text: Meaty pho, very fast service and approachable staff. Accessible and well ventilated.

author: Kim-Jimmy VELOUSAMY
review_text:
One of the best Pho we’ve had in Ho Chi Minh!
You should try. Each place has his own Pho and this one was our second best.

author: Ondřej Kaloud
review_text: Fresh herbs, good pho, I just expected different type of noodles

author: Ebbe Klinth
review_text: The best soup I've had in Southeast Asia so far! Absolutely delicious.

author: J G
review_text: I enjoyed the Pho here, we had been drinking on Bui Vien Street and really appreciated a good meal, reasonably priced and tasty

author: Jeremy Britanico
review_text:
Good pho! Very tasty but not the cheapest, it is affordable tho.

Clean, good service, the environment is not the most quiet, in fact, too many locals bugging you for your money.

Service is good too!

author: M&L
review_text:
Absolute Foodie Must-Visit! This HCMC Gem Blew Me Away.
Honestly, finding O Tinh House was the highlight of our trip to Saigon! It’s tucked away just enough to feel like a genuine local secret, and the food here is on another level entirely—not just your average Vietnamese place.
The menu is so creative. It's Vietnamese fusion, but they nail the flavors perfectly. You absolutely have to try the Bone Marrow Beef Noodle Soup (Bún Xáo Tủy Bò). The broth is slow-cooked for hours and has this incredible depth and richness. We also loved their Loco Moco twist, which sounds random for HCMC, but trust me, it’s amazing! Everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and seriously impressive.
Beyond the food, the vibe is cozy and clean (major plus for the air conditioning!). The staff are genuinely friendly, and the owner is super welcoming and speaks great English, giving you that perfect hospitality experience.
If you’re bored of the typical tourist spots and want a truly exceptional meal that balances tradition with new ideas, just go here. Excellent value for money, too. We’re already planning our next visit!!

author: David Nguyen
review_text: Great spot that's foreigner friendly and a good cleaner introduction to Vietnamese food vs the street carts. The charcoal banh beo was amazing, first time I've seen that spin on that dish. The bun thit noung was good but not great. I'm used to the grilled pork having stronger flavor with more smokiness. All in all a nice place to beat the heat and get some food.

author: Jasmyn Johnson
review_text:
Really tasty food! I had the pork vermicelli and it tasted so fresh and the meat was seasoned to perfection 👌
My partner had sugar cane shrimp and bone marrow beef Pho which she also enjoyed! Friendly service. They charged for the wet wipe I didn't use... I mean it was 6p worth so I didn't really care and I'm sure if I said they would remove it.

author: Dump Dump
review_text: Love the lemongrass chicken rice and the sugarcane prawn (appetizer). Very authentic taste. Nice deco. Personable service. Price is fair for the great quality.

author: David Owen
review_text:
The best food and service received in Saigon.
Loco moco and Bun tran(dry beef noodle with side broth) were amazing. Sad we visited on our last night. Highly recommended

author: Joao
review_text: I have to say the food at this restaurant is really good — totally worth it. I wish I had discovered it earlier so I could’ve visited more often. I highly recommend the bone marrow beef noodles; just thinking about it makes me want to go back. The service is also excellent. Thank you so much for the great experience!!!

author: William Zitzmann
review_text:
Was a rare 10/10 meal for me. Loco Moco was so delicious. The texture and flavour of each part meshed together really well. Rice was nice and crispy. The lemongrass patty was perfectly spiced and nice and crispy. The sauce really tied the dish together. I wanted another plate right after.

The shrimp on sugar cane was the best I’ve had and the spicy dip really complimented it.

author: Anna Maria Sotiraki
review_text: Interesting options for food, drinks and desserts and tasty good. Everyone was very nice and polite! The prices were aligned to HCMC prices. The bathroom had some very beautiful flowers! Only positive impression 😊

author: KC
review_text:
I was looking for a place where we could try all the different street and common food in one location. We have been having the same old restaurants that serve the usual restaurant dish and I finally stumbled upon this gem.

First up, the service was excellent. I could see our server (in cool black glasses) always looking over at us and dropped everything so she could attend to us immediately. English was also very fluent.

The food was the real stand out here. Though portions are average, the quality of the dishes really shone. We ordered about 8 different dishes and most of them were well prepared. Their menu was not too extensive and we could try a little bit of everything. Even the coconut water was amazingly cold and tasty.

My favourite was the black rice cake, loco moco (yeah it's not Vietnamese) and the meat on a sugar cane thing. Excellent and a definite choice for me to return to bring my future guests. Price was extremely value for money too.

author: lucy gillings
review_text: Cannot recommend enough. The owner has adapted Hawaii'n with Vietnamese cuisine (his mum's) recipes. Absolutely perfect 👌🏾

author: Ryan Adams
review_text: Overall, an excellent lunch. Service was a bit slow, but very friendly, and the fried oxtail was too chewy, but everything else was excellent. The BBH with bone marrow was quite good - good enough we ordered another bone marrow. The hen (baby clams) was very good, although perhaps just a touch sweet. The loco moco was excellent - better than any in the States that I have had. The Jasmine IPA from PSB on draft was fantastic. And they were nice enough to bring out crayons for the kids.

author: Jade Jimenez
review_text: GREAT FOOD! GREAT SERVICE! The drinks were so tasty. Reasonably priced. It was raining and the employee at the door held an umbrella for us to walk to our grab. Waiter was very helpful in guiding us to order. Overall had a great experience here

author: SeefoodEatfood
review_text: Honestly it was so damn flipping good. I enjoyed every bite of the Vietnamese loco moto. The owner is very friendly and nice. The environment is quiet and great to enjoy your meal. Deserves 10 stars!!

author: Wocka
review_text: Enjoyed Sugar Cane Shrimp for entree to share with the wife who also had the Bone Marrow Spicy Beef Noodles ( Marrow was melt in your mouth ) and I had the King Grilled Beef Short Ribs .  Drinks of  a coconut and watermelon juice . But that didn’t stop them topping up the supplied glass of cold water with a slice of lemon constantly . Our Service Lady was amazing and even the friendly doorman had was a huge positive to the atmosphere. Total of 649k was fair for beautiful meals , great service and a nice night out . Christmas music and the Christmas tree up at the start of November was enlightening and added a smile to our faces . Thank you !

author: justin chang
review_text:
Love the ambiance of this joint. Was greeted by the doorman and they have the loveliest staff that is attentive and conscientious of your needs. I personally didn’t get a cocktail but they looked lovely as ever and was shocked to see that they had a Jasmine IPA🤤 to quench my thirst.
Although, the real showstopper was the bone marrow soup that I ordered and I absolutely couldn’t get enough of the bone marrow😩
The location of this place is amazing because it is centralized and walking distance to all the iconic spots within the vicinity.

author: Tanya Nguyen
review_text: Excellent modern-fusion Vietnamese food. Our group tried almost everything on the menu and it did not disappoint. Highly recommend the pork chop—so simple yet so flavorful. The atmosphere was intimate and comfortable, would be great for a date or family meal. They even had crayons and toys for our baby!

author: Lyn Long
review_text: Undoubtedly the best food in Saigon! Wish we had discovered it earlier. Not the standard Vietnamese dishes  but items like bone marrow beef noodle and lemongrass oxtail. the desserts were phenomenal - the Chunky Monkey was delicious!  A small restaurant (so best to book), but relaxed, lovely ambience. Very reasonably priced. Highly recommended.

author: Narcisa Szabo
review_text:
If you’re looking for a great spot with delicious food, this restaurant is an absolute gem! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality that made us feel right at home. The atmosphere is cozy, perfect for both families and couples.

The menu offers a wide range of options that will please even the pickiest eaters. We tried several dishes, and everything was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented. The portion sizes were generous, ensuring no one left hungry.

All dishes are bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. Their desserts are the perfect ending to the meal, with rich, indulgent treats that the entire family will love.

Service was prompt and friendly, and the staff made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. This restaurant truly understands what it means to create a welcoming, enjoyable experience.
Highly recommend it for a delicious, memorable meal with loved ones!

author: Grace Crawford
review_text: Very unique menu giving an unorthodox taste of Vietnam with western influences tied in. Everything we ate was very tasty and presented well. The servers were so nice and attentive and it was a lovely experience. For being a fancier restaurant the prices are fair, the portion sizes are a bit small though so keep in mind to order an appetiser or dessert

author: Lydia Halliwell
review_text: Amazing tasty food! We came here as a recommendation from our hotel staff - it did not disappoint. We had the grilled pork vermicelli noodles and bone marrow broth and beef noodles.  Both dishes were excellent, freshly made and  full of flavour! Highly recommend visiting!

author: Sano Chia
review_text:
Joi serves hearty, wholesome plant-based food served with a heart. The pho was lovely. Pesto pasta was tasty and the ingredients used were simple and fresh. The ambiance is great to spend an afternoon chilling with friends or working on your laptop as there is ample space to choose your own cozy spot at Joi. Would love to come back and try other items on the menu.
Thank you for the experience! We had a joyous time.

author: Hieu Nguyen
review_text: The most favorite drink here is Jasmine tea with Coconut juice that is very fresh and healthy. The food here is okay with broken rice or pho noodles. Bread sometimes quite dry and so much toppings (for myself) :). Restaurant vibe upstairs is cozy, nice and Staff service is friendly, flexible

author: Tom Bosschaert
review_text:
The Joi Factory is something else. Yes it's a great place to have a coffee, eat, and meet friends. There's regular events as well, and the atmosphere is unique in saigon. But beyond that, the organization invests in social and environmental causes more than most places. It's also a meeting place for likeminded folks.

Can't recommend it enough.

author: Hannah Katz
review_text: If I could give this restaurant 10 stars, I would. Everything is above and beyond - the food is delicious, the service is fast and kind, the ambiance is peaceful and inviting. There is also a coworking space which is a great environment. My only regret is not finding this place sooner!

author: JayBee
review_text: You do not have to be vegan or vegetarian to enjoy The Joi Factory. We were staying at Christina’s, so coming here for food and drink was convenient. The space is clean and comfortable with different seating arrangements and there is a second floor as well. We ate here two times and both times our food was very good. We ordered smoothies, coffee drinks, pasta, Spring Rolls and the Broken Rice. The food and drink were well prepared and well presented and flavorful. The iced Avocado Coffee and the iced Coconut Caramel Coffee were both unique, bold and smooth. The Milk Coffee,  although simple, was sharp and full bodied while the Healthy Heart smoothies was a treat that wagon sweet. Good WiFi and clean WC. It’s worth a trip if you are after a unique dining experience.

author: Olga Bobykina
review_text: This place is a hidden gem! Food is delicious I always come back for my favourite dish and take coffee with a bottle of homemade cashew milk. Atmosphere is so calm. A lot of places to sit. TheJoi never disappoints me ☺️

author: Andreea Cecilia
review_text:
Such a cute place! Not only the drinks and the food are delicious, but the place and the atmosphere are lovely, so many good vibes!
A must visit when in Saigon!

author: Julie Monast-Nadeau
review_text: Great experience dining at Joi Factory. The food was very good and enjoyable even for non vegan/vegetarian. Great service and absolutely beautiful space.

author: Filthy Vegan
review_text: Finally made it to this vegetarian restaurant. Very nice Vietnamese vegan food. Lovely decor inside. Wide open cool looking interior. One of the nicest places I've visited anywhere. Friendly staff. Well done.

author: Mai Huong
review_text: The food was great, so delicious even they're vegan, Vietnamese cuisine. Drink was good as well but run out of some interesting coffee. Small place but cozy and located in the alley of center of Saigon. Seem they have live music at the weekend. Reasonable price, quick service, but we can't pay by credit card since their machine wasn't working. Pet friendly restaurant, as my friend brought her poodle there few times. Clean restroom.

author: Carrick F
review_text:
Incredible place! The staff are so lovely, the food is some of the best around - and completely vegetarian/vegan. The atmosphere is laid back and accommodating for everyone. You will often see many locals enjoying the space throughout the day.

We loved coming in on a Sunday to see the staff preparing meals together for the less-fortunate in the local community.

The staff always greet you with a smile and you can see that they genuinely love what they do.

Highly recommend!

author: Cédric Lignier
review_text:
The food at this place is outstanding. We ordered a ban mi (highly recommend), spring roll (highly recommend too), + 2 different rice noodle bowls.
Oh and the desert! We tried the cheese cake and while pretty small it was delicious!

The atmosphere at this place is also amazing. It is pretty much a co working space with 3 floors that offer plenty of space and great light quality.

We will definitely come back for another chill few hours at this cafe!

author: Georgina Leason
review_text:
Came here and was so impressed, genuinely had incredible food, it was so delicious!!
The staff were so friendly and spoke really good English. The space is so calming and welcoming, I really enjoyed it here. Thank you so so much!
(Also haven’t been asked to do a review- this is a genuine original review, one of the only places who hasn’t asked for a review!)

author: Marie-Eve Racine
review_text:
Tucked away in a small alley, but well worth the detour. Quality food at very affordable prices, often with a special to introduce a typical dish. Sometimes they offer a combo with a drink with the plate, and that's worth it too.🤓

There is also a water station if you don't want a special drink. The decor, ambiance, and space are all very pleasant, whether you want to eat or have a drink while you work.

We went there almost every day after we tried it, so much did we enjoy it. The staff is super friendly and helpful, making it a must-visit restaurant in our eyes.🤗

author: Phuong Thuy Le Nguyen
review_text:
A café and vegetarian restaurant with a spacious, sunlit ambiance, elegantly decorated and filled with a charming collection of old, quality books.
The vegan food is delicious, drinks are decent, and prices are slightly high but reasonable for its prime District 1 location.
Perfect for solo visits or groups.

author: Sebastian Rodriguez
review_text: Amazing plant based food. Honestly the best I had in Ho Chi Minh City, especially the banh mi! The customer service was immaculate as well and the space was extremely atmospheric. Could see myself studying or working there. I also wanna know how the meatballs are made that go in the pho. Oh also definitely try the matcha with oat milk and coconut water. So good!

author: Hang Tran
review_text:
Really a nice place for meals and drinks. I like the drink. The food I ordered was ok. The price is nice. The place looks beautiful but small. It was crowded when I visited. There are books, which is a big plus. There are also healthy products with reasonable prices.
I like the owner's style although I don't know her.

author: Emi
review_text: The food was so nice and the atmosphere was very calming and enjoyable. Had to revisits the next day. Can highly recommend the banh mi.

author: Vũ Thị Kim Chi
review_text:
A bit pricey, but totally worth it. The bún Huế and bún riêu were absolutely delicious, while the spring rolls were just okay.
The atmosphere like a working space, good place to work then have a food later

author: Thien Do
review_text:
10/10. Enjoyable as always. Highly recommended for others.
I left a review for the vegan restaurant but I enjoy being here for the open mic so much and I had friends over here numerous times for drinks so I'll leave another one.

Today I went for the open mic and ordered guava juice. The juice is good and tastes absolutely natural.

Service was good as usual. Friendly host for the event.

The atmosphere was amazing.

author: Harry Dang
review_text: Nostalgic at every turn. From the moment you entered the alley till you set foot into the courtyard and sit down it is like you are transported to countryside of a bygone era. Food is just like what you would expect grandma to cook at home.

author: Anna Pham
review_text: Stepping into the restaurant, I was transported back to my childhood visits at my grandma's house, thanks to the charming, ancient decor. However, I found the service quite slow, and the food didn't quite impress me. Even with a reservation for lunch, I still had to wait 30 minutes without any acknowledgement or care from the staff. It was a bit disappointing overall.

author: P M
review_text:
Several dishes on the menu were not available.
We ordered a vegetable dish and they brought it to another table. When we asked to bring it to us they were out of it.
Left kind of hungry.
Not the best experience.

author: Đan Nhi Nguyễn
review_text:
The atmosphere is cozy and not too loud.
The food was fresh, herbs and fruits complemented the dishes.
A little crowded, but the service made up for it.
A lovely experience overall.

author: A P
review_text: cute garden patio. decent typical home-style dishes. but not a standout. cozy atmosphere at night.

author: Jordan Cotton
review_text:
Just opened and just….wow!

It’s like stepping back in time to Vietnam in the ancient times. Amazing food, better ambience, perfect setting.

For westerners/foreigners wanting a traditional Vietnamese, ancient countryside experience in the city - then this hidden gem will be for you.

It will not be hidden much longer. Trust me.

author: Matthias Gobert
review_text: You step into another world when coming here. The setting is so peaceful and authentic Vietnamese. And the staff welcomes you with a smile! Would definitely recommend!

author: Flan Tran
review_text:
An ancient house in the middle of Vietnam, not big but that make an amazing ambiance.
Food is delicious and well decorated.

author: 11 Lê Tuệ Giao
review_text:
The food here was fairly decent, and the security guard was genuinely kind and helpful, which I really appreciated. However, the attitude of the staff was extremely disappointing. When the restaurant got busy, they seemed indifferent and unwilling to assist customers properly. It’s a pity, because with better service, this place could be much more enjoyable. The marketing campaign on 20/10
is such a ridiculous story:)

author: Pei Qin
review_text: Very nice Vietnam authentic food! The staff service is very good and knowledgeable in providing recommendations. Very worth to pay a visit! Recommend to call for booking before walk in.

author: Tin Nguyen
review_text:
At the time I was here, they could not handle the large crowd... food took 30 mins to arrive, decor is nice though...

The retro decor is nice, but they need to be aware of cleanliness because this is a restaurant + coffee...

author: Christian Chiu
review_text:
it’s a very pretty place, and it seems like a super popular spot for photo taking

the food itself I found was just okay, and relatively pricey depending how much you eat

author: Thao Le
review_text: Staffs are so nice and service is good. However, if you stop serving any course, please take it out of the menu.

author: cohani tay
review_text: Social media famous. Normal food. Overrated visuals. Only for girls to take photos

author: Richard Taveira
review_text: Cozy, delicious and friendly staff - worth coming back again and again.

author: Thuong Thuong
review_text: Today I stopped by a small restaurant in the center of District 1, and as soon as I entered, I felt the familiar feeling of "Mother's cooking", reminding me of my hometown's dinner every afternoon. The wooden tables and chairs were simple, not fancy, but cozy in a very Vietnamese style. I ordered a small tray: stir-fried squash with garlic, sour soup with snakehead fish, and sweet and salty braised ribs. In the heart of bustling Saigon, sitting down to eat these rustic dishes naturally made me feel light, like temporarily escaping the noise to return to the kitchen of my childhood. It was just a normal meal, but it was delicious in a way that I would remember for a long time.

author: photo archive
review_text:
Cam Thi Restaurant offers diners a familiar and cozy feeling, like returning to a traditional Vietnamese family home for a meal. From the moment you step inside, the space creates a warm impression with its simple and rustic decor. The wooden tables and chairs, along with nostalgic decorative items, allow you to easily slow down, forget the hustle and bustle of the outside world, and fully enjoy your meal.

The most outstanding feature of Cam Thi Restaurant is its cuisine, which is deeply rooted in traditional Vietnamese family cooking. The dishes here aren't elaborate in presentation but focus on familiar, easy-to-eat flavors that are very appetizing. From stews and soups to stir-fries and fried dishes, everything evokes memories of a home-cooked meal, with balanced flavors, harmonious seasoning, and not overly greasy. The feeling when enjoying the food is one of familiarity, like eating dishes your mother or grandmother used to cook.

The ingredients used are fresh and carefully prepared, so the dishes retain their natural sweetness and well-rounded flavors. Each dish is simple yet profound, becoming more delicious with every bite. In particular, the home-style serving enhances the feeling of togetherness, making it perfect for family, friends, or colleagues gatherings.

Besides the food, the ambiance of Cam Thi is also a major plus. The restaurant isn't overly large but is well-arranged, creating a sense of privacy and warmth. The soft yellow lighting combined with the old-fashioned decor makes the meal feel relaxed and peaceful. It's an ideal place to eat, chat, and share everyday stories.

Overall, Cam Thi restaurant is a very worthwhile visit if you love Vietnamese home-style cuisine and want to rediscover a familiar, simple feeling. The cozy atmosphere, delicious and easy-to-eat food, and the memories it evokes make this place not just a place to eat, but also a place to feel connection and love in every meal.

author: Quang Chi Do
review_text:
I chose Cam Thi when a foreign friend wanted to eat Vietnamese food because it has three things:

1. A true hidden gem of Saigon: I've always believed that how a restaurant "hides" itself is also part of the story. Cam Thi didn't choose the bustling facade of Ho Hao Hon Street. They chose a side alley off Alley 53. This isn't a coincidence; it's a deliberate experiential "architecture." You step into the small alley, and an old wooden house appears, a door completely separating you from the outside world.

2. A culture of "contact" through a shared meal: Instead of ordering individual dishes, we ordered a home-style meal. This is the most valuable "culture." We shared braised meat, picked from the same plate of stir-fried vegetables, sipped from the same bowl of crab and water spinach soup, and shared clams and rice crackers…

3. The space, the story, and the food are all meticulously prepared. I rank Cam Thi in the mid-range nostalgic segment. The price is very reasonable for an excellent experience right in District 1. It's more upscale than a typical casual eatery, but warmer and more intimate than fine dining at other famous restaurants they've visited.

After the meal, my friend said, "This is not just a meal, this is a story."

Cons: Very crowded during peak hours; people are wearing traditional Vietnamese long dresses and headscarves and taking tons of photos.

If you want a quieter atmosphere, choose a time after 1:30 PM.

author: Huynh Nhu Nguyen
review_text:
I stumbled upon this "secret recipe" while attending a meeting in District 1 and happened to find a great restaurant. The food was delicious, seasoned perfectly, and very appetizing. The coconut-flavored pork belly was unique and addictive. The dessert, like the "xu xoa" (a type of jelly dessert), was also excellent. I wish there were more vegetables, because the stir-fry was fantastic.

I noticed many people taking photos on the restaurant's wall. You can combine it with a traditional Vietnamese dress (áo dài, bà ba), or something similar to create a beautiful photo shoot with your delicious meal.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Dr. The-Hiep Nguyen
review_text: Quan Ngon - Bun Cha Ha Noi serves the best bun cha in Saigon! The ground beef is incredibly tender, and the light yet flavorful fish sauce is so good you'll want to drink it straight! You also need to try their Vietnamese egg rolls (cha gio or nem ran) too. From the street, the restaurant may look small with just three tables on the first floor, but there’s more seating on the upper levels. Despite being located on De Tham, in the heart of the bustling Bui Vien Walking District, the place remains clean and surprisingly quiet. The staff are courteous and friendly, making for a great dining experience. Highly recommended!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Kong Wen Sheng
review_text: This is a famous Bun Cha store apparently as my queen brought me here for lunch, first proper meal of the day and trip. Very satisfying and delicious! This has set a high standard of food for the trip and nothing hardly beats it for the next few days. We ordered fried Spring rolls too! The tables on top could hardly fit both of us a we are both XXL in size 🤭

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Luís Tiago
review_text:
Very good, in a high pace Street.
Kinda small but you can get the local vibe.
The food was very tasty, and the spring rolls were of a decent size and full of flavour...
All the staff attended our needs and were very helpful.
Fast and funny

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Ida Bagus Putu Surya Nanda
review_text:
I had a great dining experience at Quán Ngon – Bún Chả Hà Nội. This place is a solid choice for anyone wanting to try authentic northern Vietnamese flavors, especially the famous Bún Chả.

Pros:
• Authentic taste: The Bún Chả here was flavorful and satisfying. The grilled pork had a nice smoky aroma, the broth was fresh and well-balanced, and the herbs and noodles were generous and fresh.
• Local vibe: The restaurant has a simple, clean, and local-style atmosphere. It feels very genuine and relaxed, which adds to the experience.
• Affordable prices: For the quality of food, the prices are very reasonable. It’s definitely good value for money.
• Friendly service: The staff were friendly and tried their best to assist, even though their English was limited. Their helpful attitude made the experience pleasant.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Herman Soh
review_text: This place has the best meat ball I've ever had. The lady is so friendly. The food is very clean. The restaurant is air-conditioned and clean. Highly recommended!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jackie Here
review_text: Tried the bún chả here and it was great! The flavor is spot on — tasty, balanced, and not overwhelmingly spicy, just the right kick. Satisfying and definitely worth trying if you’re in the area.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Manrit Leon
review_text:
Had an amazing dining experience here! The food was absolutely delicious — especially Bun Cha which was full of flavour and perfectly cooked. Big thanks to our tour guide, Kevin from The Tour Bros, for recommending this place and giving such great explanations about the local food and culture. He really made the experience extra special! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Vietnam 🇻🇳 .

- 🇲🇾

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Eva Athanasaki
review_text: Delicious food! We had the special bun cha with the spring rolls and we loved it! Flavourful and fulfilling! The spring roll was one of the best ones we had! Do not miss this place!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Ella Lucas
review_text: Traditional bun cha was amazing! Also had the fresh orange juice, it was very good. First meal in HCMC and it was 10/10

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Thomas Allison
review_text: What a place!!! Only three things on the menu but god, they are so good! The soup was excellent with the meatballs so tender and tasty. The spring rolls are the best I have ever had.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Bernadette Guanine Barte
review_text:
I came in thinking it was a rice meal, I was disappointed it was noodle (I am a rice girl). But oh my goodness, the noodles delivered. I never expected it to be THAT delicious! Really really delicious. Can’t stress that enough.

Such a small place but SO GOOD!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Gemma Gilbert
review_text: This is the best Bun Cha in the world! Possibly my favourite meal I had all throughout Vietnam. Super fresh noodles with the most perfectly balanced broth and incredible meat balls. So good we came back twice.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jenny Drysdale
review_text: Enjoyed a lovely meal here. The food was fresh and delicious, the service was attentive which made for an enjoyable experience. The vegetarian spring rolls were just so good. Well done on providing a a great place to eat.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jacqui Nelson
review_text: Best vegetarian meal I had in Ho Chi Minh - I came back again just for it! The bun cha was deliciously fresh with a range of delightful flavours, and the spring rolls that came were crispy and packed! Thank you!!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Michael EY Lee
review_text: Underrated place, not crowded but serves the real authentic and delicious Vietnam food. Reasonable pricing.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jesus Estrada
review_text: Went for lunch on a weekday. It was busy, but I was seated quickly. The staff are helpful. It's a restaurant that caters to tourists, with tourist prices and strong aircon. The menu has pictures and English descriptions. I ordered the special set. It arrived quickly. The meat pieces were tasty. The spring roll was thick and crunchy, but not particularly flavorful. The noodles with the sauce were very good. The leftover sauce was great, I drank it all. Paid with a card.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Lova Lova
review_text:
I am speechless! The food is absolutely delicious, always fresh and tasty! This is my favorite restaurant in Saigon. Hands down, the best bun cha Ha Noi I have ever eaten.
I always end up eating here whenever Im visiting. Staff’s attitude is always great as well😊

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Andrej Žižek
review_text:
Good Vietnamese pork belly strips. The patties were just ok, less smoky than most places in Ha Noi. The soup is good especially by adding the calamansi lime + garlic + chopped 🌶 chili. We were pretty satisfied.

Complete or special set 100K + meat only 60K + Spring Roll 20K = 180K nett. As expected because it is in touristic area (9 Aug 2025)

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Ossi
review_text: One of the best food experiences in Ho Chi Min. Absolutely delicious food with quick and friendly service. Atmosphere is like eating at a Vietnamese home.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jonathan
review_text: Bun Cha set with extra meatballs and spring roll ordered on grab. Food came quickly, packed in individual boxes to ensure freshness. Grilled pork and meatballs were well seasoned, spring roll crispy and delicious. Wrapped with lettuce almost felt like a Korean meat wrap

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Areej Bishara
review_text: Amazing Vietnamese food! Everything was super delicious and the menu is really diverse, with great vegetarian options too. We wish we had discovered this place from the first day we arrived! We didn’t even have a reservation, and even though the restaurant was completely full upstairs and downstairs, they seated us within seconds. Sky, the girl who served us, was incredibly polite and kind, and the service was unbelievably fast. One of our best experiences in Vietnam! 💛🇻🇳

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Michelle Wong
review_text: The food is amazing, love the black coffee which has very nice after taste and also egg coffee!!!  The staffs are very friendly and especially Bi who always has a smiling face throughout and very professional. He is also very considerate that when we ordered too much, he stopped us.  When we asked for recommendations for one more dish, he explained since we had ordered fried spring roll, hence he will suggest the non-fried.  Very considerate!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Yiee Tiee Chan
review_text: Very nice and delicious vegetarian food! The dishes were fresh, flavourful, and prepared with great care. Special thanks to Han for the excellent service — she was extremely polite, attentive, and impressive with her ability to speak multiple languages. Her warm hospitality made the dining experience even better. Highly recommended!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Alexandro Gould-Arocha
review_text: An excellent restaurant with unbelievable vegetarian options. The first time I went here I tried a vietnamese pancake for the first time and it was one of the best things I've ever eaten. The staff here are wonderful and attentive. Shoutout to the manager James for his excellent service. He even dropped me off near my hotel when the street was flooded- what a great guy. If I come back to Saigon, this is one of the first places I'll visit.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Tyler Bechtold
review_text: Food was phenomenal - and was served exceptionally fast! Kim was our server for the evening and was very attentive to our needs and made sure to make us feel welcome. We got the fresh shrimp rolls, fried spring rolls, beef pho, and the stir fried chicken with chili and lemongrass. This was our first stop upon arriving to Vietnam and we’re happy it was. Thank you so much De Tham! ❤️

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: An Chee
review_text: The food were delicious and the service was excellent. Peter was especially friendly and patient, he even took the time to teach us the best way to enjoy the pancakes. Really appreciated his warm and attentive service. Highly recommended!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Jens W
review_text:
We had an outstanding dinner at De Tham in Saigon. From the moment we arrived, Sky took care of us in the warmest and friendliest way – it truly made us feel welcome.

Our starters and main courses were extremely tasty, so good that I almost wanted to order them again right away. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared.

The coconut coffee and the egg coffee were also excellent – rich, unique, and definitely something we’ll come back for.

A wonderful restaurant experience with fantastic food and heartfelt service. Highly recommended!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Aleksandra M
review_text: Everything was fresh with a lot of taste. There’s also big variety of food to choose. My father took catfish that you prepare by your own so it was nice experience. All of the places are inside but there’s one bar table on the balcony which we took

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: blossom
review_text:
food is quite nice and we enjoy the chicken fried rice.  the portions were good and everything was served fresh. however, the mushroom aroma was a little stronger than what I’m used to, but that’s just personal taste.
Snow was very attentive and friendly throughout our meal, making sure everything was okay. Great service overall!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Preston Wong
review_text: Our server Kim was friendly.  Spoke English very well.  Ambience was relaxed. Tourist hot spot. Ordered the stewed catfish (no picture), seafood fried rice,  bokchoy veggies, banana flower salad & banana split.  Food was tasty and not bland or over salty.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Christine Cordova (xtineecordova)
review_text:
We’re tourists visiting the area, and we had such a wonderful experience dining at De Tham Restaurant. The atmosphere was welcoming
A special thank you to Peter, our server, who was very friendly and attentive. My mom preferred rice instead of vermicelli for her dish, and Peter gladly accommodated our request without any hesitation. It’s a small gesture, but it really showed their excellent customer service.

The food was delicious and freshly prepared. a great way to experience local flavors. Overall, we had a smooth and enjoyable dining experience, and we highly recommend this restaurant to fellow travelers!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Siang Leng Tan
review_text: Yuta has been very attentive and helpful. She speaks English, very well. Helped to manage our food order, otherwise we might have over ordered.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Thalia Gonzalez
review_text: 5 stars all around!! I had my first Bun Cha and my lovely service Mari helped me in showing me how to eat it. A bit on the expensive side for Vietnam, however, the food and service make up for it! Another thing to note, you’re able to pay with a credit card without an additional fee. Great place overall!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Danny Carratala
review_text: I had a wonderful dining experience at De Tham Restaurant! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented — a great mix of authentic Vietnamese dishes and tasty vegetarian options. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to enjoy a meal. A special shout-out to Snow, who was absolutely great — friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for delicious food and great service!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: XinTong Pang
review_text: The food was awesome we finished it all. Mari was very helpful with her service as well. She demonstrated to us how to wrap a spring roll, and checking up with us frequently. This is a great place to experience vietnamese culture and food together as we can do the spring rolls by ourselves. People that do not want to can also order normal spring rolls. The restaurant is very inclusive, having a great variety of vegan and vegetarian vietnamese food options available.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Philip Cheng
review_text: Lisa is a very service oriented crew and she really serve us with her whole heart! Kudos for Lisa! The food is extremely nice and the portion is big! I definitely will come here again for sure!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Beatrice Tan
review_text: Had a wonderful meal here! The food was delicious, and the service was excellent. Special thanks to James for being so helpful and attentive!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Alex Broad
review_text:
While the weather was hot out side, it's was nice to walk in to a cool video with a good tunes playing in the background.

Grabbed a booth seat, so comfy, then Peter (awesome waiter) took my order, he was super friendly and talking about everything local, so many insights.

When the food was brought out, so delicious, and I may have ordered to much for one person, but still so good.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Putthachard Weera-achakul
review_text: Kim is very helpful and kind to show us the correct way to wrap our roll. All diahea are delicious and highly recommend for the Vietnamese pancake, one of the best we ever had with thinest flour. Prdered 5 dishes and all gone very fast!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Sara B.R.
review_text: Great food and service! This was our first meal after arriving to Vietnam and it was delicious. Out waitress, Sky, was extremely nice and explained us how to eat the dishes we ordered - fab service

author: Paul Alty
review_text:
I used to go to The Hungry Pig quite a lot when I was in the area, and I must have worked my way through most of the menu. My go-to was usually the full breakfast — you really can’t go wrong with it, and the sausages and the hash browns in particular are excellent.

If you’re looking for something a bit lighter, the Caesar salad is top notch, with proper chunks of succulent chicken. And a special mention for the garlic bread — it’s *proper* garlic bread. I’ve had some pretty dire garlic bread in Saigon, but theirs is genuinely good.

Other highlights for me were the BLT (of course), the British Pig (not offended by the name 😉) which is English muffin with pine-smoked bacon and egg, and the Porco Rosso, which I thought was outstanding. The burgers are excellent too.

Hats off to the kitchen staff: the food was always consistently good every time I visited, which is really what keeps you coming back.

The atmosphere is nice and chilled, and Jasmine and the rest of the team are lovely and always attentive.

I’d highly recommend The Hungry Pig if you’re in the area.

*Pictures might not be great, I'm no photographer but rest assured, it tasted excellent*

author: SD
review_text:
The Notorious P.I.G was a tasty toasted bacon baguette. The bacon was crispy providing a great crunch to the sandwich. It would’ve been nice if the cheese was slightly more melted though. It was paired perfect with an iced Vietnam coffee. The service was prompt and friendly too. Great spot for a quick breakfast bite.

My only regret was I forgot to try a hash brown, guess I’ll have to go back

author: Abhrajit Choudhury
review_text:
The Hungry Pig: Where Bui Vien’s Chaos Meets a Culinary Twist

Tucked away in the labyrinthine alleys behind the ever-buzzing Bui Vien Walking Street, The Hungry Pig isn’t a café you stumble upon — it’s one you discover. Hidden behind the raucous hum of backpacker bars and street music, this unassuming spot has earned a reputation that quietly travels through word of mouth.

This café isn’t chasing authenticity in the traditional sense. Instead, it delights in reinvention — a playful collision of East and West. Think King Kong meets Godzilla, but on a plate. The result is familiar comfort food with an unexpected Asian edge — bold, inventive, and surprisingly harmonious.

The menu reads like a witty conversation between culinary cultures. Forget about finding your standard Bodega Sandwich or Molesey Beef-Dripped Chippy. Here, the creativity lies not just in the recipes but in the names themselves — clever, tongue-in-cheek, and impossible to resist.

Here’s what stood out during my visit:

All Day English Breakfast – crafted by someone who truly understands that the way to a man’s heart is undeniably through his stomach.

Fish & Chips – a nostalgic nod to home, though I found myself longing for those traditional beef drippings (curse you, healthy living!).

Hamlette — bitten by the Bard, yet a charlatan in the written arts; but, I dare say, a master in the divine art of cookery.

Pig Lebowski – hearty, unapologetic, and undoubtedly made by Dudes for Dudes.

Notorious P.I.G. – because some dishes don’t just speak; they declare.

Each plate carried that satisfying blend of humour and heart — a café that doesn’t take itself too seriously yet delivers on every bite.

So, next time you’re wandering through the chaotic charm of Bui Vien, take a detour down its quieter corners. There you’ll find The Hungry Pig — a tiny nook where fusion finds its fun, and brekkies might just last all day.....Cheers!

author: Ellie Cameron
review_text: We came across ‘The hungry pig’ on google recommendations as it is so close to our accommodation. We are SO glad that we did! The staff are so brilliant and friendly - super welcoming. Thank you Hannah and Helen. The food was absolutely delicious! We are going back for breakfast tomorrow! We also tried our first Vietnamese Iced coffee which is delicious if you like sweet coffee 11/10.

author: Lizzie Maltby
review_text: Reasonable price for what we got. We got the piglet combo, which was nice but needed sauce adding to it. We also got the Notorious P.I.G, which was good but also could do with some sort of sauce as it was a bit dry. Overall it was a good brunch place.

author: Ollie Boon
review_text: Great breakfast with proper sausages! Upstairs there’s a nice Aircon room as well, which is nice in the hot weather. Nice for breakfast or brunch and definitely recommend.

author: Cliff G
review_text: I really liked this place. Its tucked away on an alley close to walking street but its more spacious then you'd think.  The service is fast even though they're dealing with a lot of orders. The food was delicious and they allowed customization.

author: Dallas D
review_text:
Great food and coffee — I had an omelet and a perfectly brewed cup, a proper breakfast to start the day.

But what truly surprised me was not only the food, but the artwork on the walls. Some of the drawings and paintings here are over 30–40 years old. For those who take the time to look closely, this place is not just about breakfast — it’s like a small hidden gallery.

A café worth visiting not only for the food, but also for the meaning carried in these artworks. 🌿

author: Antoine Francois
review_text:
Obvious 5 stars review

Honestly best burger in Saigon for the price

First: it’s not like those trendy place that sell you a burger without fries which is an abomination.
Here you get the whole package, and that’s definitely how it should be.
And you also get it for a very reasonable price 125~140 against 220~300 for other places.

Second: The bread is not mushy, the bacon is incredibly crispy, the sauce is good, meat is nice.

Definitely recommend it 🙌

author: Ross McMillan
review_text: The sandwiches here are amazing, so many good combinations and you can make your own. Staff are super cool too and speak great English.

author: Boo Cooper
review_text: Came here three times during our trip to HCMC and it was some of the best western food we’ve had! Staff are so lovely and kind too!

author: D. Sanders
review_text: This was my go-to breakfast spot during my month in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. They serve made-to-order American breakfast, so don’t worry if you don’t see a standard option listed on the menu—they’re happy to accommodate. The Vietnamese coffee is excellent, and the cozy, mom-and-pop atmosphere makes it especially welcoming. The service is outstanding, with Jasmine and Hannah going above and beyond—they even memorized my usual order after just two visits. A warm, friendly place and a perfect way to start the day. I’ll definitely be back on my next trip to HCMC!

author: Theo Judge
review_text: Amazing place with wonderful staff. The food is always delicious and very fast service even when busy. We can hear more than once and it never failed us. If your looking for breakfast / lunch food anywhere in Ho Chi Minh make it this place

author: Caitlin Anderson
review_text: First proper English breakfast we have found that is just like home! While the full English is more expensive than all the other items, it was definitely worth it. We also had the egg and bacon bagel which was lovely. Upstairs has AC and they offer you a seat upstairs straight away, great service and a great meal.

author: Sierra Kushneryk
review_text:
Really cute place with great food!
I got the Miss piggy breakfast and ice coffee, it was great! Wish I was here longer so I could have it again.
Fast service too.

author: Sara Meagher
review_text: Had the British pig two days in a row and it was amazing ! The girl who served us was super nice and helpful! I definitely recommend. The price is very reasonable too!!

author: lisa moore
review_text: Amazing food and people! Highly recommend this wonderful restaurant if you are in town. Will definitely be back!

author: Kilian Chasseriaud
review_text: Sandwiches are unreal and at an amazing price. Can’t recommend this place enough. The bacon and egg crumpet is so good and is only 50k. Will have to come back to try all the rest.

author: Petman X
review_text:
Very delicious food
extremely friendly and welcoming staff, would recommend to try everything on menu because it will blow your expectations

author: Shane
review_text: Absolutely best place we’ve been in the whole of Vietnam for breakfast and burgers, lovely owner and staff, excellent consistent tasty food, I fell in love with Bacon cheese burger, so juicy and tasty, also had a few full English breakfast’s with big mugs of Twinings tea, if your missing a good fry up that’s not greasy, or a juicy burger, then this is place to go, defo give it a visit if your in walking street. They also do really good muffins and French sticks, BLT was my wife’s favourite, super crispy with plenty of filling, oh and the iced coffee is really good too, in fact we tried nearly everything  of the menu and loved it all 😙👌

author: Lamemamabear Sonja
review_text:
A hole in the wall type, local back alley type food, off the “night life” street.
6 of us sat in this small little joint over stainless steel tables n chairs and had dinner, while a small Vietnamese family runs the business at a super affordable price.
The owners speaks decent English and very warmth, like going back to a family home.

We ordered 2x Bun, 2 broken rice with extra sunny side eggs, 2 beef stir fried noodles, 2 sides of spring rolls, and 4 drinks, 2 Large beers, which came out to be a total of 410,000vnd, it’s insane.

We would definitely return, small place and we were so glad we opted for a local street joint for dinner

author: jessihizenberg
review_text: Anh Mâp Restaurant is a straightforward local spot with budget-friendly Vietnamese food. Nothing extraordinary, but everything is decent: portions are filling, flavors are honest, and service is quick. A good choice when you want something simple, tasty, and cheap.

author: asssa ssaa
review_text:
It's a great place because it's cheap and the food is delicious.
That's why local children often come here.
You'll see arrogant white people pretending to be regulars loitering around here, mistaking it for a bar.
Do not smoke near children eating.
Just because locals do it often doesn't mean it's okay. I think it's a basic courtesy that tourists should naturally observe.

author: Artur Pytel
review_text: I just love local places like this one. You need to pass a labyrinth of side streets but it's an adventure worth taking. Food is prepared by a local elderly couple, the guy speaks English, prices are very low and food tastes great. For all on the picture I paid 65k VND, including beer of course.

author: C.J. Kendall (She Her)
review_text: This is my absolute favourite place to eat near Bui Vien / District 1. So authentic, some of the most lovely owners. Such amazing value. I never buy food in Bui Vien - go into the lanes, be adventurous- best thing I did in Vietnam. This is where the life energy of the area is.

author: Simon Heath
review_text: Great little mom and pop restaurant serving home made food, nothing fancy. The prices are cheap and the portion sizes are good. My fried beef with macaroni was super tasty and the spring rolls well cooked. These both and a soda, 90k. Highly recommend.

author: Adam Fente
review_text:
Absolutely delicious lunch here at Anh Mâp Restaurant!

I had the Egg & Pork Fried Rice, Bún Thịt Nướng and the Pork Spring Rolls.

All three items were freshly made and tasted fantastic.

I love how this restaurant is such a hole-in-the-wall, it has such a local charm and ambiance to it.

I can't wait to return here again!

author: Thallyta Cracco
review_text:
Don’t be scared by the look of the restaurant, THE FOOD IS EXCEPTIONAL! I am a chef and the food is really delicious. No doubt, it was one of the best fried fish I had in a restaurant.
While I was there, 2 couples came following maps, but when they saw the place, they turned away and left. It’s really a pity for them and for the ladies who cook. My advice is here, leave your preconceptions outside, and try it.
It’s cheap btw.
Just take a seat and go, you won’t regret, they know what they are doing.

author: Baes Lea
review_text: Food is really nice and service is good, really welcoming as it at your grand parent’s house ! I recommend !

author: Yuliia Kartamysheva
review_text: Delicious dish and welcoming staff. Very local atmosphere, feels like visiting grandma’s house. Prices are good too.

author: Li0neL Ng
review_text:
I'm a foreigner trying to taste local food as my friend suggested me (small stainless steel chair, small restaurant in a small valley, local foods).

I didn't want to ruin other people money making restaurant, but for me almost all vietnamese food kinda plain (I ordered beef chowfun)

But my friends like it (they ordered macaroni fried beef & pork chop with rice)... It's cheap, smells good & fast

And the ahma/grandma is still welcoming us even its already 21.30ish

author: Dylan
review_text: This family run restaurant has the best fried rice. They will modify to your liking and is SO cheap. I like the chicken fried rice with egg

author: Nic Hallberg
review_text:
Really cute authentic street food shop in a small alley. Food was amazing, best food I had in Saigon so far. Ordered the Pork neck and salt fish fried rice.
The chef is a lovely lady and all seems clean and orderly as well. (They have a huge fridge)
Felt confident to go here and wasn’t disappointed!
I’ll be back every day.

author: Xinchen Tang
review_text: Very cheap price and good quality food, the owner can speak English, I didn’t order any drink and he served me a cup of tea for free, this fried rice is only 35000 and it’s very delicious, they have other different meals as well. I recommend this place. The tables are also very clean.

author: Jarrett Hobday
review_text: Hidden gem. Very ‘local’ feel eating here & the people were super friendly. The food was fantastic and affordable - I went for the beef stir fried noodles. Would definitely recommend.

author: Jo Shuttleworth
review_text: We ate here in 2018 on our first trip to Vietnam and were so glad to return in 2023! Delicious food and plenty of choice, friendly welcoming family. We tried many of the noodle dishes and the chicken with cashew nuts and rice. Highly recommended!

author: darren peng
review_text: Located not far from Bui Vien Walking Street, this charming family-run restaurant may not catch your eye from the outside, but don't let appearances deceive you. The owners' warmth and hospitality instantly make you feel at home, while the food is nothing short of amazing. After enjoying a delightful dinner on our first day in Ho Chi Minh, we're already planning to return for another culinary adventure. Their menu boasts a diverse selection of dishes, but it's their delectable fried chow fun and bitter melon egg that truly steal the show.

author: Lukasz Mamcarczyk
review_text:
Cheap, authentic and friendly, what else would you want? Highly recommend. I've been here maybe 5 times already and not once I didn't like something. The dishes are fresh and tasty, I recommend the chicken with cashew nuts, spring rolls and fried rice. You will not regret coming here. Chicken leg was so crispy and literally mouth watering.
To get here you just need to walk down the alleyway, not that hard to find.

author: Serge Boudreault
review_text: Very simple, cheap good food. Eaten here many times. Good tofu dishes.

author: Flying White
review_text: Had dinner here and couldn’t fault it. I had the chicken with cashew nut plus spinach with garlic dishes, total was 65,000D. Nothing fancy, just a good cheap place to eat

author: Trung Chu
review_text:
Tried Hanoi Kitchen recently and really enjoyed their Cà phê trứng Hà Nội (Vietnamese Egg Coffee). From the first sip, it was creamy, smooth, and comforting. Sitting outside on the street with a cup of egg coffee felt calm and peaceful, almost like being in Hanoi during a cool autumn morning.

What impressed me most is that they do several authentic Hanoi dishes very well. The Chicken Pho, Hanoi Bun Thang (traditional Hanoi noodle soup), and Bun Cha (grilled pork with vermicelli) were all flavorful and tasted true to Hanoi style, which is not easy to find in Saigon.

The restaurant is newly opened. I passed by before when it wasn’t open yet, so it’s nice to finally see it open. The location is also very convenient, within walking distance of Bui Vien Street, Ben Thanh Market, and close to Bánh Mì Huỳnh Hoa.

A lovely place to enjoy real Hanoi flavors and take a relaxed break in District 1. Highly recommend for Hanoi food lovers.

author: Bea Aguinaldo
review_text:
Food: They serve Big portions And the price is just right. The menu is only limited because this is their specialty.
