I had a fantastic dining experience at Pizza 4P’s in Da Nang. The food was really excellent — from the fresh, flavorful pizzas made with quality ingredients to the rich pastas and refreshing salads. We ordered the Salami and Chorizo Margherita and were given the chance to make it half and half.

What stood out just as much as the food was the service. Our server, Ha Vi, was friendly, attentive, and professional. They spoke good English and helped in making it easier for us to order, even during a busy evening. I felt well taken care of from start to finish.

author: Anna Balingit
review_text:
The food was incredible! Everything we ordered was delicious, from the pizza to the pasta, and drinks. The atmosphere felt cozy and welcoming, perfect for a relaxing dinner.

Special mention to Vu, who took such great care of us. He was attentive, warm, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. Really appreciated his service; it made the experience even better.

Highly recommend this branch. Would definitely come back! 🍕✨

author: Jordan Lloyd Si
review_text:
When I first stepped onto this place I was greeted by waiters who efficiently brought us to our seats. I was quite amazed by the atmosphere, mixing a contemporary with industrial style making the place a vibe.
Upon ordering our food, the food came out pretty quickly and after taking a bite of the food I was blown away by the quality and freshness of the dishes. A waiter even offered to make my drink for me so that I did not have to have the hassle of making it myself.
Overall, the immaculate service, atmosphere and dish quality makes me understand the hype of this place and I recommend visiting this place when you visit Danang. 🔥🔥

author: K Carter
review_text: This is a phenomenal restaurant that exceeded our expectations. The food is absolutely delicious. I wasn't really a pizza lover but now I am! The Spicy Garlic Shrimp pizza is superb! More than that, the Caprese salad with Dalat Tomatoes and hose made mozzarella is very flavorful. The mixed green salad with the house made garlic basil salad was a very delicious healthy start. Coupled with delicious food is consistent outstanding service (this is our 4th time visiting in less than two weeks). Vu and Thuy are phenomenal staff that are a part of a great team! We love Pizza4’s!

author: Amanda Tan
review_text: Better to make reservation before coming, even on a weekday dinner as the restaurant is not very big. Else have to wait 1.5 hours. Best service and atmosphere over here. Thanks for the birthday surprise and gentle song for the husband. Will come back when we are in Vietnam again! The handsome waiter even offered to help us take group photo. So nice gesture! Also caught the spilled water made by the son very quickly.

author: Axel's reviews
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The five-cheese pizza is absolutely insane 🤯 Super creamy, perfectly balanced (not too heavy), with a great mix of cheeses and a perfectly cooked crust.

You can really taste the authentic Italian flavors — simple, high-quality ingredients and spot-on cooking.
If you love cheesy pizzas with a true Italian vibe, this place is a must. 🇮🇹🍕

author: YC Wong
review_text: Amazing food with amazing service. We were waiting for closed to 30 mins, they offered free drinks as a compensation. Their pizza was amazing, full of flavours with extremly fresh ingredients. I didn't expect to fall in love witb Italian cuisine in Vietnam. Will definitely be back for this again.

author: PS “PSOng” Ong
review_text: One of my best meal in Da Nang! Service staff was very accommodating and professional even though it was crowded. They were fully booked through out. Reservations is required. Please DO NOT do walk in. The pizzas were wonderful, I just love the crust. The servers were very knowledgeable and professional. Wonderful experience in my first Da Nang trip!

author: Miranda Nghiem
review_text:
Great experience. The restaurant was full but they were able to squeeze me in due to a cancellation, and if that wasn’t possible at least let me do takeout.
I got the crab pasta and burrata which was delicious. The crab was fresh tasting and a healthy portion, especially for the cost. It was great reading the menu to see how everything was sourced locally.
Would definitely come back!

author: Lala WK Wang
review_text: Staff were friendly and courteous, making the dining experience here pleasant. Ambience with background xmas music was good. Staff are able to communicate well in English and explain the menu products. Would definitely recommend and come back again for good pizzas and pasta.

author: 민트초코
review_text:
We had a really great experience at Pizza 4P’s Indochina Da Nang! From the moment we walked in, the staff greeted us with warm smiles and friendly service that made us feel welcome right away. The team was attentive without being pushy, and their positive attitude set the tone for the whole meal.

We ordered the Burrata Cheese Salad & Margherita pizza (half and half) — and wow, it did not disappoint. The burrata cheese was super creamy and fresh, beautifully paired with the vibrant salad toppings. The Margherita side was classic and perfectly balanced with rich tomato, and just the right amount of cheese. The crust was crisp on the outside but soft and chewy inside — honestly one of the best pizzas I’ve had in Da Nang.

Overall, the combination of delicious food and genuinely friendly service made this a standout meal. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area!

author: JoRdi HoBee Lo
review_text:
Highly recommend to all, this is a prefect restaurant for group gathering especially family group.
We are a group of 13people, but we did not have reservation, so that we need to wait about 10mins for a 5-person table and 7-person table separately.
Please make earliest table reservation if you want to go there. Staff service here were excellent, speaking good english and always with smiles.
Especially Ms “HA VI” , she provided professional service with passion, my family had a great time here and dishes are definitely delicious!  Thank you for your recommendation! Bravo 👏🏻

author: Rosie Espinosa C FH
review_text:
We had another great experience at 4P’s. The staff are always friendly, especially Uyen — she was very attentive to our table, always smiling, polite, and so cute!

The food was excellent as usual. It’s not our first time here, and every visit the dishes are consistently delicious.

Thank you to the 4P’s team for the warm service and great food!

author: Davis Lin
review_text: Nothing special about the pizzas here except for the good service by the friendly waiters. Ordered a few pizzas and spaghetti. The spaghetti had little taste maybe due to it being too creamy. The pizza was good and you can request for the pizza to be sliced into how many pizzas. Atmosphere was peaceful and fantastic and you can get a good view of the bridge on the 2nd level.

author: Lydia Lee
review_text: this is our must visit place anytime we come to vietnam. incredible food, great vibes and amazing service by all the staff. our server Vu was extremely helpful, attentive and enthusiastic, delivering above and beyond 5 star service!! he helped us take great photos too and really made our night! we will definitely visit again and be sure to look out for Vu 🥰👍🌟

author: Brian Yung
review_text: Our very first meal in Vietnam was at Pizza 4P’s - was recommended by multiple friends and it did not disappoint! Fantastic pizzas, great service, lovely atmosphere. Get a seat at the pizza counter to watch the chefs work their magic if you can.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Luboš
review_text: I appreciate that this Vietnamese restaurant is open from early in the morning. The portion (40 thousand dong) was nice and slightly spicy. However, I was a bit surprised that the Bánh mì was empty when it was served to me.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Zheng Yang
review_text:
So lovely, so happy to have dined here! Owners were really cute and welcoming even though I don’t speak any Vietnamese… Anyway, the food is so lovely, lots of topping for their special bowl. I wish I could have it again.

Thank you for being good at what you do and being so passionate! Cam on! 😻

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Linda Yonemoto
review_text:
Excellent steamy hot bun bo hue dac biet (special beef noodle soup bowl with lots of toppings) for 50k. This version came with cha, blood cube, sliced meat, pork leg with skin on, green onion and cilantro. Added 5k for the crisp banh mi. The broth was very flavorful. The pickled garlic and carrot in a jar were a delightful addition. There were also green chiles, limes, dried red chiles, and fish sauce on the table. I left the restaurant happy and very, very full and committed to returning again.

The family that operates the restaurant is friendly and nice. Pricing is transparent. If you are a tourist/foreigner, don't hesitate to come here. It's across a school and lots of families eat in the good and extra clean restaurant. Tip: the price varies according to toppings. Just like a pizza, the more toppings or more premium toppings will be more money. You can get a lower price bowl, but I highly recommend the dac biet for 50k. It's very delicious and lots of food. Come early! It's a great spot for breakfast and the restaurant was extra busy in the morning.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Cyndi
review_text: Place was really clean, the owner was very sweet and friendly. Ordered mixed oxtail, came with all sorts of beef parts, everything was tasty, only wish that the broth was hotter, it was warm ish

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Joie
review_text: Very good bowl of noodles - my Singaporean taste buds love it. It’s just a little spicy with sourness, really perfect. They give you a baguette to dip the soup but it’s super filling. The staff here are really friendly and will help with translating. Shop is also cooling and well ventilated!

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Soo Wei
review_text: Best local foods ever!! This stall sells rice noodles with beef/pork as sides. Their foods are amazing, the taste of the soup base tastes great, not too salty or oily, you can add chilli flakes which tasted better. If rice noodle is too much for you, you can opt for bread as your carbs. As a tourist, i can feel the warmth and friendliness of the owner who tried to explain their foods with simple English during our order. The price is cheap and i would definitely recommend to all of you, will come back again when i visit Da Nang. 😍

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: EL
review_text: Popped by sorta by chance as I had a sudden craving for something spicy — the food was SO good, owners extremely welcoming, and the place so neat I feel I now should make a daily visit!! Had a beef soup and a pork soup with two glasses of sugar cane juice and it only cost us 160K.  Best value for money, and by far the best restaurant I’ve been here in Da Nang.  Would give 100 stars if I could.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Jenny Ng
review_text: Support the local. Bun bo hue here is good. My daughter is Aussie and likes the noodles and broth here alot.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Bach
review_text: One of the best bun bo hue i’ve ever had! The beef and pork is super tender and soft. Broth is very flavourful and the owners are both so nice ;’)

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Loo Wei Shyang
review_text:
Their serving is big compared to the normal portion, and it's delicious!
I'm also surprised that the portion of meat is more than their vegetables, which is rare in Vietnam with their decent price.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Kianna Nguyen
review_text: Food and service were amazing. The broth was delicious and rich with a mild kick- best Bun Bo Hue I’ve ever had!

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Katka Cinková
review_text: This happened to be a really lovely food experience. The soup was delicious, a little spicy with a nice hint of lime. You can add more chilli or some pickled veggies. The owners were lovely and welcoming. Still don't understand the price because it was nothing like on the menu, it was actually lower so I don't complain.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Jon
review_text: Absolutely fantastic Bun Bo.  Will come back next time I am in da nang.  Flavours were amazing and friendly staff.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Stephen CK Kwok
review_text: Very clean place. Stock/soup is very good. Pork is tender. Vermicelli is well cooked. Condiments (shallot, onion, lemon, green chilli are all fresh). Service by boss himself is excellent 👍. I come from Singapore 🇸🇬.  Do come and taste and enjoy.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Alex Bui
review_text:
I’m from North of Vietnam and I was here with my family on holiday. I’ve heard a lot of good things about bún bò Huế in Danang. They said it’s because Danang is so close to Hue that their bún bò is the closest to Hue’s. So we picked the one closest to our hotel.

The food is nicely priced. They don’t overcharge us even when they can tell we’re not from here. The owners are this lovely couple who were so welcoming to us. And the food portion was huge, took us a lot to finish. Definitely need to go check it out 🖤

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Bryan Nha Hoang
review_text: 100,000vnd ~ 4,5usd for a special bowl. Freaking high price in such a small restaurant like this. Bun bo was ok but really not worth the price.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Heang Malaythong-Suy
review_text: The Bun Bo was very good. The couple that owns the place were so personable and very nice. Would definitely come back again!

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Tien Huynh
review_text: The soup is very delicious and the owners are very friendly )))

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Tokki
review_text:
I came here because I wanted to eat Bun Bo after dinner.

I ordered what the menu said was "Thap Cam Bun Bo Tai Mixed Beef Soup."

First of all, the portion wasn't huge, it's Vietnamese-style, lol.

You might think, "It's a little small for Koreans."

Because I was like that... ... ;ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I wish they had both regular and large portions.

The meat had no gamey smell and the broth was clean.

The broth was so clean, I thought it would be okay for Koreans to eat, too. 🙂

I saw a review on YouTube.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: 박애정
review_text:
I found this place on Google for its delicious banh mi.
It wasn't the typical sandwich-style banh mi you'd expect from a Korean, but it was delicious.
I dipped the banh mi in a rich, rice noodle soup, reminiscent of hangover soup. It was absolutely delicious.

My two children, ages 10 and 5, loved it!
Highly recommended as a true local favorite!

author: Shariah Isabelle Gomez
review_text: I JUST LOVE THIS PLACE!! Was shopping at Han Market and I was looking for somewhere nearby to sit and relax after shopping. And this was THE BEST place to do so! Very friendly staff, and the cashier and front staff understand english well! They helped me with local coffee roasters, as well as giving me great recommendations for other places to go to! Ha Vy, Phuong Doan, Thien Ngan, and Yon were the ones I spoke to, and they all were very welcoming! Excited to go back there and hoping to meet them again. Other than that, the view and vibes are excellent! I had many photos taken all thanks to the wonderful staff 🧡 (I almost forgot to add), coffee and pastries were delicious as well as affordable! I highly recommend their Salt Latte (the best one Ive had in Da Nang so far!)

author: Melanie E
review_text:
Food: 5/5 I ordered the salted matcha milk and it was excellent. They offer a good selection of teas, coffees, and smoothie drinks.

Service: 5/5 great service

Atmosphere: 5/5 a great vibe to chill with your friends.

author: preba moodley
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Ut Tich Cafe in Da Nang is a hidden gem! Their salt coffee is hands down the best in town, perfectly balanced with a unique flavor you won’t forget. The coconut coffee is undoubtedly the best in Da Nang — rich, creamy, and absolutely delicious. If you’re in the mood for something refreshing, their peach iced tea is a must-try — light, fruity, and so satisfying.

A cozy spot with incredible drinks — highly recommended for coffee lovers visiting Da Nang! 🌟

author: karan shorey
review_text: The outside seating gives this busy place a welcoming vibe. Located right opposite the river, it makes for a good view of the hectic street traffic and the calm river just beyond. I found the coconut coffee average, comapred to what I experienced in other shops in Danang/Hoi An or across other cities. Sweetened  coconut flakes that come with the coffee are nice to nibble on.

author: Rhys Travel
review_text: Great coffees. Beautiful views to the Han river. The service was a bit slow for upstairs as there was only one server.

author: Rachel Jordan
review_text: This cafe is very spacious- and nice and cool on a hot day! The drink glasses are huge. We had the Strawberry Smoothie and Bác Xiu- both delicious!

author: Marcus Yong Chee Kuan Yong
review_text: This seaside spot is absolutely stunning—breathtaking views and a peaceful atmosphere. Highly recommend stopping by to relax and unwind!

author: Tani Wade
review_text: Fabulous coffee and pastry shop! We love the coconut smoothie and coconut coffee! Friendly staff, many many of them. There is outdoor and AC seating. Overlooking the river. Reasonable prices and fast delivery of food. Can takeaway or enjoy at the restaurant.

author: Christine Doan
review_text: Wonderful coffee house with beautiful river & city views. My cousin brought me here & i was very impressed by the ambiance. The decor gives a nostalgic vibe (ex. vintage sewing machine & media (cassette/radio players). I recommend the coconut coffee. ☕️ Will definitely return.

author: Rob
review_text: What's not to love about this place. Awesome smoothies, great friendly service with a smile, great atmosphere as you sit and watch De Nang go slowly by.

author: Kimberly T
review_text: Fun and yummy drinks, cool space to escape the heat, or sit outside and enjoy the riverview. We got a brown sugar boba and a tamarind drink with peanuts.

author: Eden Dayuha
review_text:
I came to relax and chill but it's impossible because the music is too loud and vehicles passing by are too noisy as well.

Their drinks are the best, though. Highly recommend this cafe for just a short stay, I can't stay longer in a noisy place like that.

author: Dita Ling
review_text: Arrived here way too much early at 7am,but the staff team is so welcoming. The whole cafe has very good atmosphere and relaxing vibe, enjoys the Vietnamese pop music, chilling. Recommend the coconut coffee with coconut flakes. Super addictive.

author: JustLinahere
review_text: We went there to kill some time before leaving for the airport. We sat outside and ordered mango smoothie and peach tea. Both drinks were refreshing. But we couldn't enjoy it, we had to endure some tobacco smokes since we were in the open area.

author: Cielo Tierra
review_text:
We were looking for shelter from the rain and decided to step into this café. What a pleasant surprise! We loved the decor, the different seating areas, the location, and most of all, the quality of the coffee.

Another great highlight was the excellent and fast service.

author: Jan Goergen-Makinson
review_text: We popped in for our usual coconut coffee and salted coffee. They were delicious. The coconut flakes were so crunchy and just perfect.

author: Paris Andrews
review_text: Absolutely delicious coffee and a lovely refreshing smoothie. Usually when travelling we like to try different places but definitely coming back. I did a little dance of happiness when leaving 🕺

author: Corey
review_text:
📝 Summary: you pay the price for the trending location by the river, but you get a nice atmosphere to eat and drink a good coffee served by friendly Staff.

🏠 The setting is very nice, beautiful decoration style and the staff is LOVELY! They're smiling, helpful, speaks English, helped me understand Vietnamese money(my first day) and even cross the busy street traffic!
👩‍🍳 You can seat on small individual tables or group up on comfy sofas, upstairs has clean bathroom and balcony for more intimacy.
As always I find the music too loud(style is typical electro-pop) like everywhere in south Asia it's not specific to this café.

🥯 They have a few bakery/pastry (35-40K) but I found the almond croissant a bit weird, maybe because of the cream stuffing inside.
The Cinnamon roll was good.
Finally the coffee, tried a hot
☕ Cappuccino (50K...ouch!) but it was good, not burning hot, correct foam/milk ratio, beautiful art.. served with an Oreo because why not.
💲I've had cheaper coffee.. but I've also had worst coffee so you get what you pay for!

author: Care LUSA
review_text:
Coconut shake here is the best!
Salted coffee try it but don't forget to stir before drink🤣. If you like to selfie I suggest this place. If you have to across the road the staffs there will help you ❤️

author: Pichitra Tovivich
review_text: Good coffee, good atmosphere, good service, and better taste than famous one.

author: Linda M
review_text: With such a reputation to live up to, sometimes it’s hard to meet it. The banh mi (roast pork #6, 40k VND) had a fresh and crispy baguette and a fair amount of bbq pork filling. I didn’t think the pate was that great and the herbs were all at one end. I normally like more sweet pickled carrots and daikon and cilantro, sadly it was so skimpy that I almost missed it. Strangely, there was some minced meat (Possibly tuna since it tasted like seafood) in my sandwich. Ordering was quick and sandwiches were made quickly. Went back for more banh mis because it’s close and the restaurant we wanted to go to want closed &!wanted to try other banh mis. We got ostrich (a little tough but well sauced) and their specialty (mixed)- these wet better with scallions for ostrich and a load of meat fillings for the mixed. Upped some of the ratings. Jan 2026.

author: Harm Rai
review_text:
Bit of a touristy place - hyped up by hotels etc - I would say a really good banh mi, especially if you like the crispy bread.

I had the chicken and cheese - the cheese had a ton of flavour and complimented the chicken quite well. The chicken itself was slight lly warm, could have been hotter. We also had the veggie (w/o avacado die to allergy). Again, very crispy bread and I think it would have been very good with the avacado.  We also had the mango lassi/smoothy which was very good, to s of mango flavour... First banh mi in Hoi An - maybe there's better out there.

author: Thomas
review_text:
An extremely popular place, rightfully so -
Delicious Banh Mi’s, good choice of drinks and well priced.
Only one small point is when you do takeaway, you don’t get access to the dips and sauces which usually help make the bread less dry, however if you dine in you get access to plenty of different dips kept on your table.
A couple of chilly sauce packs for takeaway would be nice (many places do that already).

author: Shu
review_text:
It was actually very easy to find this place because many people were waiting outside, but the line moved quickly.

My wife and I ordered the mix, BBQ pork, passion fruit juice, and mango juice.
The BBQ pork was a little spicy, but very good, and the baguette was incredibly crispy.
The mix is their signature Bánh mì, and it was absolutely delicious and full of flavor.

I’ve really been into Bánh mì on this trip, and this shop is the best place for any Bánh mì fan.
If you come to Hoi An, you should definitely try it.

author: Gino Haddad
review_text:
Being a huge Banh Mi fan, I made it my mission to find the best one in Hoi An. The top contenders, of course, were Banh Mi Phuong and Madame Khanh (The Banh Mi Queen).
We started with Banh Mi Phuong, it’s the one that Anthony Bourdain famously loved, so expectations were high! Both places have indoor seating, which is great since you can actually sit down and enjoy your sandwich comfortably. I ordered a pork and a chicken banh mi to compare fairly.
Unfortunately, the chicken banh mi at Phuong’s was quite a letdown; the meat was dry, the filling wasn’t generous, and the pâté didn’t have much punch. The pork version was better and had more flavor, but the bread could’ve been fresher. Overall, it just didn’t live up to the hype.
Next stop: Madame Khanh, and wow, what a difference! I ordered the exact same sandwiches, and this time I was blown away. Both were packed with ingredients, full of flavor, and the pâté… OMG 😲 unreal! The BBQ pork was my absolute favorite, but honestly, I’d order both again in a heartbeat.
So yeah, for me, Banh Mi Phuong sadly lost this round. Maybe it’s not quite what it used to be back in Bourdain’s day. Hats off to The Queen 👑 she completely lives up to her title! 🥖

author: Ong Lee Huey
review_text: Good banh mi with vegan option as well! I love the coconut coffee, very creamy and coconuty and the stir fry morning glory with rice is honestly a family favourite despite its simplicity. Definitely has the "wok hey"! The chicken rice is great too! Overall highly recommend and price is reasonable despite being a tourist spot. Do try out the local huda beer if you like light beer.

author: Russ Lacuata
review_text:
Located in the Old Town Hoi An. The restaurant is very popular and long queues, but it is worth it! The queues is endless, but the staff does an excellent job managing the orders.

The baguette is fresh with the right balance of crunch and chewy. The sauce is delicious and well seasoned, family secret and the filling of meats and pork are amazing.

The price is reasonable. The best Banh Mi.

author: Honest Asn Travel Reviewer
review_text:
Ummm not too sure why this place is so busy/popular?

The banh mi is your average banh mi. Didn't  think it was anything special tbh.
Had their special with the mixed meat.
It was crispy and fresh. But again, just average. Maybe I'm just not a big fan of banh mi.

It's a good thing we came early so there wasn't much of a wait. Definitely wouldn't be too happy if I had to wait for it 😂.

You have to pay when you make your order so get your cash ready!

author: Renee Richter
review_text:
This place is popular! The banh mi’s were so good and prepared fast. We had the tofu/avocado and the bbq pork. Very tasty. Juice took longer to make (we had lemonade and mango) but was fresh and really good. Reasonably priced. We spent about 150k vnd for 2 banh mis, 2 juices and 2 waters.

I would avoid going her around lunch time— you won’t get a table. There were three tour groups that came in while we were waiting for our food and they gave them tables first. However, there is a park across the street and it is nice to sit and eat there.

author: Juju Miano
review_text: Love the banh mi here so good and super affordable. I also tried their stir-fry noodles and loved them just as much. Simple, tasty, and great value for money. Definitely a spot I’d come back to again.

author: Devon Patterson
review_text:
There’s a lot of hype around this place because of the Bourdain feature, so I was curious to finally try it. I’m not a famous traveling chef, but with all the attention it gets, I expected something standout. The banh mi was… fine. Pretty average compared to other spots in Hoi An.

One thing I did like is that they offer more than just sandwiches. I had the cao lầu noodles, a Hoi An staple, and those were actually pretty good. It’s nice to have options if you’re not in a strict banh mi mood.

Overall, it’s worth trying once if you want to see what all the buzz is about, but in terms of flavor and experience, there are other places in town that impressed me more.

author: Bob Pham
review_text: If it weren’t hyped up I’d give it a 3.5/5 star rating. The age of social media does not help. Hoi An has so much more better banh mi vendors, and the social media hype does not play fair. TBH the bread is nice but the ingredients were quite average quality and silly enough felt like it was tweaked for tourists, thus a trap for tourists.  We can certainly say that people will fall for this one time only lol. Personally if you want bragging rights then find your way there and eat the hyped banh mi and take a selfie at the front of the store. Otherwise Hoi An has so much to offer and people need to be held to their words when recommending such places. Perhaps people who recommend these places need to share responsibility for misleading others to such vendors.

author: Dominik Wroblewski
review_text: The sandwiches they serve here are really good. I was skeptical at first but the ingredients they use are not of cheap quality processed meat but have whole chunks of meat as well as their homemade pate. I've ordered the sandwich with chicken and cheese and grilled pork with pate. Both were great and couldn't really tell which I preferred more (make sure to add their own chilli sauce). Avocado smoothie was perfect. The salt coffee was good too but a little bit too sweet for my taste. Overall pretty good value for the price paid. This place is clean and most times of the day full of customers.

author: Gary Arnesto
review_text: Both the kids and I were on the mission to taste the best banh mis Da Nang has to offer. The best recommendations always come from the locals, this shop was a recommended by our driver/guide. It did not disappoint! The baguette was warm and had a crusty shell but soft interior. I think the portioning of the ingredients and spices were on point. They asked upon ordering if we wanted them spicy which was a plus. We liked it so much we went back the next day and ordered 5 more.

author: Mindful Cooking
review_text:
This banh mi spot right at the entrance of Hoi An is impossible to miss thanks to the constant queue outside. The menu is simple and clear, and you can see everything being made fresh by hand as you order. They offer vegetarian and pork-free options, plus self-service drinks, and payment is easy with cash or card.
The seating is basic and not the cleanest, but it works. The place leans into its Anthony Bourdain connection, which adds character, even if it could be showcased a bit better. Service is fast and efficient, and they bring the food straight to your table.

The banh mi itself is excellent. Crunchy bread, soft inside, fresh vegetables, great balance of flavors, and plenty of sauces on the table. Easily the best banh mi I had in Vietnam. Very affordable, authentic, and absolutely worth stopping for. I’d definitely come back.

author: Emma Betts
review_text: Our tour guide recommended this spot, and my husband was not disappointed. As you can see, the bánh mì was so good it was lifted into the air like Simba on Pride Rock. 10/10 moment, 10/10 sandwich.

author: Casey Namana
review_text:
Best Banh mi I’ve had in Hoi An. It definitely lives up to all the hype and the price is amazing.

The best part or what made them so amazing is the quality of the pate. You can tell it’s heavily seasoned and has been cooked twice which I haven’t seen in many Banh mi restaurants. It’s definitely what makes it taste so good. The bread is very light and crunchy it holds the sandwich together well.

The ingredients are all very fresh and the turn over of ingredients is so quick. There are 5 chefs working to assemble the sandwiches at all times.

There is an inside seated area if you want to get off the street or out of the heat/rain.

The hardest part is dealing with the Instagram/tourists who aren’t sure how or where to order or wait for their food.

I came back here 3 times and tried two everytime. One isnt enough try two at a time it’s a good amount to be full but not bloat yourself as one just makes you want another one.

author: Harriet Cooper
review_text:
Went to try this as it’s supposed to be one of the best places for Banh Mi in Hoi An. It really didn’t live up to the hype. Because it was so busy we got the barbecue pork one to take away and it was ready in a minute.

The bread and filling was nice but the whole thing was cold and it wasn’t the tastiest one I’ve had since being in Vietnam.

author: Manisha Purwaha
review_text:
OMG, I think this was the best banh mi so far I had in Vietnam so far.
We had bbq pork and pate, mixed (pork and pate), beef and cheese, chicken and cheese.
The beer was very inexpensive, they had super cheap beer and coconut lassi, if you like the taste of dried coconut you will like it ( I did not).

My rating/ranking (as per me)

1) beef and cheese
2) mixed (pork and pate)
3) bbq pork and pate

4) chicken and cheese (skip skip skip)

Super fast service, the line was so long that we almost skipped the place but all reviews were pointing back to Phuong, so we trusted the people and reviews.

author: Eduarda
review_text: Good Banh mi in the city center. They have many options but to my taste the pate is one of the best I’ve had. The place is small and often packed with tourists, so I recommend getting your food to go and enjoying it in the square across the street.

author: J
review_text:
Comfortable and quaint little coffee shop with old school decor and outdoor style theme.

The drink quality is very consistent, and the staff here are quick to remember what you usually order or like. The Brown Saigon style iced coffee was my favorite item to get here, strong coffee with the right amount of sweetness. The drink quality and flavors are top tier, and is better than some of the more popular chains found in Danang. Would highly recommend giving this place a shot if you have never been.

They also have two cats which are well taken care of that will also socialize with patrons. :D

author: Leah Johnston
review_text: Lots of greenery & vintage decor. They have a ground floor, rooftop, and inside working area. I had the peanut butter coffee and croissant. The peanut butter coffee was divine, and the croissant was so flaky and airy. Staff are super kind and welcoming. Thanks so much!

author: Irina M
review_text: Extremely cozy place with trees and lots of greenery around! 😻 My husband and I liked the second floor, it’s just the best place. Nice and friendly staff. Great coffee and pastries.

author: Brian “Zimo” Jin
review_text: Camping site vibe with beautiful plants inside the  cafe. As you walk in, you can enjoy your little getaway from the city. I’ve been coming here almost everyday for less than two weeks of my stay in this neighborhood. I tried most of coffee drinks in the menu and you won’t get disappointed. If you are looking for a cafe to work? This cafe has a great wifi, I worked hours with my laptop everyday.

author: ms __
review_text:
Cozy café with charming outdoor camping vibes. Drinks and bakes were decent, and there’s a deck dining area on the second floor along with an air-conditioned indoor space. Cat lovers will be pleased to know there are resident cats around; the grey one we met was especially friendly! Just a heads-up if you’re not a fan of cats.

Card payment accepted with a 3% processing fee

author: Belle K
review_text:
It's a cute spot. You're surrounded by greenery, and it's very chilled, no unnecessary frills.
We had a salted caramel cream white coffee and a peanut butter cream white coffee which were very nice. Unfortunately, the croissants were terrible, but in their defence, we haven't found anywhere in Da Nang or Hanoi that do croissants well, so maybe the dry texture might be the preference here.
Would definitely come again for the coffee.

author: Marina N.
review_text:
Little gem near our hotel and decided to visit from the reviews.

Chill, relaxing and casual dining style. There’s fans around you can use for your table.

We got coconut and salt coffee - different takes on them from other cafes but are delish and refreshing.

Got to say hi to the kittens who wonders around but they’re mellow and leave you alone. Decent pricing too!

author: Jigme
review_text: Spacious with an upper deck. What I like about their coconut coffee was how they served the shot separately with the coconut milk and forth. It was in standard price VND 45K.

author: Ryan Dickinson
review_text: My wife and I came here a bunch of times during our stay. The coffee has a wonderful rounded flavour to it, our favourite Vietnamese coffee so far! Also def worth trying the sugar free banana bread, super tasty.

author: Lena Völlger
review_text: Really nice hidden coffee place in Da Nang. For me the best coffee I had in Vietnam 😍 The Bananabread was also very delicous! You shouldn't miss out this place!

author: Prima Shella
review_text:
Went here twice during my stay in Da Nang. The cafe is well shaded and very cool even though it is scorching hot outside.

Here's the menu I tried:
- Peanut Butter Cream Coffee (original and white) - The balance between the peanut butter cream and coffee is very delicious, the cream is smooth and velvety, combined with strong coffee below - I prefer the original one, but the white coffee one is also good (creamier)
- Brown Coffee Saigon style - I guess it's kind of like shaken espresso coffee. It has a very unique taste - creamy and the coffee is bold
- Caramel flan - I think this is one of the best flan I have ever eaten, it's not overly sweet and it's very creamy

They even sell coffee beans which is very affordable (140k VND) - available in whole beans / grinded

Overall one of the best coffee I had in vietnam. Will definitely visit again when I came back to Da Nang !

author: A. M.
review_text: I went to this cafe based on my hotels recommendation and it is a very peaceful spot that I really liked. The banana bread was good and the potion size was big. The mango smoothie is rather heavy, I think it contained yogurt but still very tasty. They also gave me free ice tea.

author: むむー
review_text:
I've been in Danang for the past 1 months having 2 coffee everyday, the worst coconut coffee I've ever had.

First, I came in and ordered medium coconut coffee and waited 20 mins. There's a 6,7 drinks order before me so I accept to wait but when I went to ask when my coffee is coming they totally forgot about my order.

If the coffee tasted good, I wouldn't even complain because anybody can make mistake. But the coffee which came late was just 70 percent ice blended, bery subtle coconut flavour and made me regret coming here.

The atmosphere is nice, with some fan located around the chairs.

author: Andrew Ardis
review_text:
I'll start this with a "not new to coffee, but new to vietnamese egg creme coffee" as I'm sure most of you are .

I got the classic salted egg creme coffee iced, all I'll say is WOW! One of the better cups of coffee I've ever had, honestly. It was so robust and in the same time so creamy. The salt on top was the perfect balance to the deep flavors of the coffee first , then creaminess of the egg foam and the salty noted to finish off the experience. Each sip was so fulfilling that next time I'll probably get the large size. I didn't try any food but the pastries looked nice and fresh! The kind of place you can sit for hours and enjoy the slow life. Free wifi, and plenty of seating with 2 levels .

Will definitely return and will definitely recommend.

Atmosphere 10/10
Staff 10/10
Coffee 11/10

author: Choco Zee
review_text: Love the vibes of Acacia. The banana chocolate is so delicious and great coffee. The service is tiptop!

author: Ece Kavuncubasi
review_text: The best Vietnamese black coffee in Da Nang. They also have sugar-free banana bread that’s absolutely delicious. A great spot to hang out and play with the cute cat.

author: Eden Dayuha
review_text:
Acacia Coffee - A Unique, Green Oasis for Nature Lovers

Acacia Coffee is an absolute paradise for those who appreciate nature-inspired spaces. From the moment I walked in, I felt like I’d stepped into a hidden forest retreat. The cafe’s design is earthy and inviting, with wooden furniture, gravel floors, and lush green plants hanging from every corner. It’s a refreshing break from the usual cafe interiors, and the abundance of greenery adds a serene and calming vibe that’s perfect for unwinding.

The layout is spacious, with plenty of seating options, both for groups and individuals. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the decor has a rustic charm that makes you want to stay for hours.  You can work, read, or enjoy a quiet conversation without feeling crowded.

Overall, Acacia Coffee is a delightful escape for anyone looking to enjoy a unique ambiance and delicious coffee. It’s an ideal spot for nature lovers, remote workers, or anyone who wants a peaceful place to recharge.

Downside:  There are many mosquitoes inside and the room smells like molds. The lady staff was grumpy and didn't even bother to smile.

author: Frank Lauda
review_text: The waitress/manager told me she makes the banana cake without sugar, only a bit of honey. Great coffee, service and relaxed atmosphere.

author: Ak
review_text: It’s a nice place especially when you wanna refresh and chill or have a chat with your friends. The garden is well designed and many low chairs are installed and those are actually pretty comfy ones. There is also an AC room with workable long tables if you wanna open your laptop. Their tiramisu was not great, but it’s very good for the price of 25k and the drinks were good.

author: Millie Eu
review_text:
I have never tasted such nice coffee.
The PEANUT BUTTER CREAM COFFEE was out of this world. I would highly recommend coffee lovers or non coffee lovers to try everything on their coffee menu and also the banana chocolate cake.

author: Sam Wong
review_text: Our first stop in the Ancient Town, and we had a great lunch! The restaurant has a beautiful interior, and some tables offer a stunning view of the river. The staff was attentive and patient while introducing the dishes, and the food was delicious. Overall, it was a wonderful experience with great food in an elegant, chill atmosphere.

author: Graham Barry
review_text:
A premium choice: you get a creative and delicious menu served in an atmospheric riverside restaurant. The team was warm and attentive but had limited English to answer a question about allergens. As most diners were on the way to the Memories Land show, service was prompt.

The short walk to escape the intensely touristy core of Hoi An is rewarded with dining which is higher quality and costs less. This is a very popular place - we were lucky to get a table spontaneously - so a reservation is always a good idea.

author: Kimberly Smith
review_text: Beautiful detailed Restored building ,offers several areas of seating. we chose near the river.  Delicious local food with a  beautiful presentation.  service is very welcome. I will return before leaving Hoi An !

author: Arash Yazdani
review_text: Fantastic spot in Da Nang right beside the river. Attentive service, very clean and amazingly flavorful local foods. Highly recommend!

author: NICHOLAS WONG
review_text:
The restaurant is really beautifully decorated, artistic and creative with local traditional cultural touch on every aspect of vietnamese culture.
We were served with the most delicious foods in  variety from skewers, shrimp salad, chicken rice and soups.

author: Gabriel Oleastro
review_text: Absolutely amazing authenticate Vietnemese food. Extremely friendly and attentive staff. Beautiful setting along the river, we could even see a small parade on the otherside of the river and we could also watch the boats with their beautiful lanterns cruising past. The entrance and inside is also very romantic and set up well.

author: Hanli Bubu
review_text:
Love the service and the food!
We had white rose, pancake and beef pho which was the local cuisine. Or you can also opt for their combo set 180,000/pax. Avocado smoothie was awesome

author: Uyen Tran
review_text: Always come here for lunch whenever we visit Hoi An. Everything is great, good food, good service and atmosphere. Try “cơm âm phủ” - the best dish ever!

author: Good Person (gercog)
review_text: Cozy spot by the Hoa Hien river in Hoi An. Pineapple fried rice with juicy prawns, a bright citrus–seafood salad, and crackling bánh xèo wrapped in herbs. The green sauce sings. Kind staff, fair prices, calming water views. We left full, smiling—and a little in love with this place. Truly loved it!!

author: Amanda Allen
review_text:
I am staying by the river in Hoi An and pass this lovely restaurant daily. I did stop and have drink, the other day, but thought I’d try something to eat.
I ordered the white rose dumplings, which were very nice …. I will definitely come back in the evening for something a bit more substantial!!!
The restaurant is very clean and decorated very well.
Staff are polite and friendly.

author: Venecia Wong
review_text: I came here with my family for lunch and the food was such a variety and absolutely tasteful and delicious. Really enjoyed my afternoon here it was. Everything was pleasant and the staff was really attentive and helpful. I will come back again!

author: Dinato Podcast
review_text: I love the vibe and aesthetics here. Staff are so nice and the food is so great and affordable. I highly recommend it here

author: Paula Calleja
review_text: My family and I came to have lunch and loved this restaurant. We had the set menu with papaya salad, dumplings, grilled chicken and eggplant. Everything was delicious. I am gluten free and I was able to eat everything in the menu. I would very much recommend it.

author: Chea Voon Hung
review_text: A nice cosy restaurant with real authentic Vietnamese cuisine. The fish soup is particularly good. The setting is very cultural, a lot of good corner to take great pictures

author: Donna Donato
review_text: Very nice ambiance. Great food and service. We got the set meal, pho, scallops, and coconut juice.

author: Viaan Dodhia
review_text: Queen was amazing and helped me with my first time hotpot which I had at this beautiful restaurant. The staff is super friendly and excellent ambience and service. Must come for great food and awesome view.

author: anais siba
review_text: The place is beautiful and quiet. A lots of space so you don’t feel to much pressure. Also the view on the river is lovely. The waitresses are professional and nice. The food was tasty and well proportioned 🫶🏼

author: Hien Duong
review_text: An excellent place to try authentic Vietnamese food in Hoi An. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and reasonably priced. The service was warm and welcoming.

author: Nguyen Thanh Tam
review_text:
This restaurant offers a beautiful and peaceful atmosphere, with seating options indoors, in the garden, and by the river.

The menu features a variety of Vietnamese dishes, not only from Hội An but also from across Vietnam. The flavors are thoughtfully adjusted to suit different guests, ensuring that the food isn’t overly sweet or greasy while still staying true to its authentic essence.

The staff are nice and caring for our needs

author: Ct Harwanie
review_text: I order a scallop. The scallops are a standout—each one delicately topped with a medley of herbs and peanut that add freshness and texture. A squeeze of lime brings everything to life, enhancing the natural sweetness of the seafood.

author: Jeffreyl Ella
review_text:
We ordered Coconut coffee and it did not disappiont us. The blend of coconut into coffee is so perfect, the coffee is strong and the creminess of coconut is the perfect combination. It has also crush coconut.

The place is quiet so you can have your relax moment and just watched the people walking outside.

Staffs are also welcoming and accomodating, there plenty of them so they can assist you right away.

This is a best place when you are with your friends after you ate lunch or dinner just to talk and have your relax moment.

Oveall, will definitely comeback here.

author: p p
review_text:
One of my favorite cafés in Hoi An. The drinks are reasonably priced, and you can relax and enjoy the river view while sipping your coffee.
The coffee tastes great and isn’t expensive.
The staff are friendly and provide excellent service.
Highly recommended!

author: samay vora
review_text:
Cong Caphe, just opposite the river, is a cozy and inviting spot.
The seating is comfortable, with a great view to enjoy while you relax.
Wi-Fi is strong, making it perfect for working or long chats.
You can easily sit here for four to five hours without any rush.
The ambience has a rustic charm with a unique vintage vibe.
Their signature salted coffee is a must-try – rich and flavorful.
Overall, a great place to unwind, work, or simply enjoy Hoi An’s calm.

author: Apple Ong
review_text: Cộng Cà Phê only accepts cash and does not take credit cards. This generally applies to most places in Hoi An. We loved the drinks here. They only serve beverages and do not offer desserts or food of any kind.

author: Bhavika Gondhalekar
review_text: I was looking for a place to have a nice coffee. I came across cong caphe as their reviews were nice so I decided to go there. I ordered vietnamese cold coffee, It was really very good. Worth it! Also the ambience was great!

author: Jayne Collins
review_text: Decided to go for one of their signature coffees, and opted for the coconut green rice ice coffee, it was like drinking rice pudding and totally delicious. The other drink we ordered was the iced coconut coffee, again delicious. Really nice peaceful part of Hoi An right on the riverside, so pleased the pilot on our flight recommended it to us. Excellent spot to escape the busy streets

author: Chutikarn Sukchote
review_text: Love everything about hoi an, especially this cafe. Good coffee, good vibe, good spot to take pic and talking chilling. The coconut coffee is a bit sweet for me but overall would be 9/10!

author: Jherson Jaya
review_text: Nicely located in front of the Hoi An River. Its nice to sit here and just observe the people. They have fast wifi too!

author: Franz Jeunesse
review_text: Cong Caphe in Hoi An is really a vibe! The atmosphere really lives up for Ancient Town type of chill. Minimal lighting inside the cafe. Less people compare to the other branch in Da Nang City. Most of the staff can speak english

author: June Thorfun
review_text:
Cong Caphe has a really cool vibe with its vintage military-style decor and cozy atmosphere. The mix of antique wooden furniture, Chinese cotton print cushions, and soft lighting makes it a great spot to take a break while exploring Hanoi. There’s a nice mix of seating, from lounge chairs to wooden tables, and the whole place has a nostalgic, slightly retro feel.

The drinks were just okay—not bad, but nothing too special. Still, the unique ambiance makes it worth a visit, especially if you like cafes with character.

author: Subhankar Dey
review_text:
Cộng Cà Phê is one of my favorite coffee chains in Vietnam. It beautifully preserves the authentic values of the country's history. The thoughtfully curated interiors always remind me of Kolkata’s vintage charm. The coffee is quite good and reasonably priced. The staff wear uniforms that evoke the spirit of a significant movement in Vietnam’s past, adding to the immersive atmosphere. If you sit by the window, you can enjoy a charming view of the river and watch the boats gently pass by.

The name "Cộng" is inspired by “Cộng sản,” meaning “communism,” reflecting the café's nostalgic tribute to Vietnam’s historical era.

author: Kiều Nguyễn Thị
review_text:
The space is quite nice and the drinks are excellent, especially the coconut coffee, which I really liked. However, the staff’s attitude was truly disappointing. They didn’t seem cheerful or friendly, and appeared irritated with customers. I noticed one staff member (K. Linh), whose attitude was particularly bad — definitely not suitable for the service industry. Good drinks won’t make customers come back if the service is poor.

On the bright side, the manager was friendly, calm, and had a good attitude.

author: Charles C
review_text: Clutch coconut coffee. I always dread when the drink is almost over. I find it very refreshing on a hot day. Just like their other locations, you can expect a good, consistent drink here. There is plenty of seating in this location.

author: sarah lloyd
review_text: Great branch of the Cong Caphe! Managed to sit in the lovely seats outside the cafe overlooking the river. The coconut coffee here is the best I’ve had while in Vietnam, very creamy and delicious! Only downside is that they didn’t have any of the food advertised available, however the coffee is great!

author: Panploy Kunket
review_text: Super hot!!! But understandable cuz we can’t control the weather tho😂 no air conditioner but fan. Coconut coffee is so gooooooooood👍🏻

author: Sumit Saudagar
review_text:
Rating: ★★★★★ (5/5)

Cong Cafe in Hoi An is a must-visit for coffee lovers! The cafe has a cozy, vintage atmosphere with a unique retro charm that makes it stand out. I tried their signature Vietnamese iced coffee, and it was rich, strong, and absolutely delicious. The ambiance is relaxed and welcoming, perfect for a casual hangout or enjoying a quiet moment. The staff was friendly and provided excellent service. The prices were very reasonable for the quality and experience. If you’re in Hoi An, don’t miss out on Cong Cafe for a true taste of Vietnamese coffee and a lovely environment!

author: Yi Wang
review_text: There are two levels where you can select your seating. I opted for a cinnamon chocolate beverage, which was incredibly creamy and bursting with a decadent taste. During the early hours of Monday, between 9-10am, the place is not very crowded. The ambiance is enhanced by the soothing sounds of old-time jazz music, making it a perfect setting to enjoy a meal and unwind.

author: Ashley Hung
review_text:
We had coconut iced coffee, which is like liquid coconut coffee ice cream, very delicious!  The cafe is located in the heart of old town Hoi An and right across from the Thu Bon River.
p.s. Cong Caphe tote bags also make great souvenir gifts for friends!

author: Hiep Nguyen
review_text:
Cong Caphe is the best. We had it in SaiGon and loved it. Glad they have one in Hoi An too!

Service is just efficient and friendly. I had knocked down my drink before even taking a sip. It was all over the floor. Within seconds 1 guy came and cleaned up the mess, another server got my another drink made in 1 min. No questions asked. That is amazing customer service 👏.

Great atmosphere and they got fans blowing from all sides. Feels nice and cool during the 30° C day. 130,000 Dong for our drinks is $7 CAD.

author: Renee Richter
review_text: Interesting coffee shop. The drinks are unusual, most are mixed with tea. We enjoyed it.

author: Ed Seet
review_text: Local meals with broken rice. The food and service is good. Go early or there'll be a long queue. Grilled chicken Thigh and Pork Chop were very nice. Tried the pumpkin flower with garlic... Not my kind of vegetable dish though... Broken rice, a must try.

author: ECA
review_text:
Good spot within a row of establishments. Good food and great service too!

Food was good, but I have no way to tell if this is better or worse than other Com Tam spots in Saigon.

I personally had the Bun Cha which tasted like the other Bun Cha I had eaten on this trip. Perhaps the consistency across all restaurants should tell me that that is how Bun Cha should taste.

Worth a visit if you’re in the area!

author: lynn koh
review_text: I din a lot as I was full. I ordered the grilled pork and fried spring roll. Overall the food was good! Especially the grilled pork. The service was above averaged, we was serve by a young guy, he recommended their must try food n beverages. He was very friendly.. Thumb up to him! Please keep it up.

author: Porter KHOR
review_text:
Food not great.  Vi Da Vietnamese eatery at Ben Thahn market was so much better.  Feels like typical chain restaurant using frozen meats cooked without any soul.

My pork chop and braised pork belly tasted like microwaved leftovers. Dry and hard at some parts. Don't get fooled by photos on menu.  The real dishes all turned out alot smaller.  Crab meat ball is one good example.

Pricey not great.  Walk out for better food .  I'll never be back here again.  Bill was 480k for two pax

author: Joyce DV
review_text: Food is bland. Staffs would ignore you. Prices does not include tax or service charge. We ordered bun cha but did not give us water for the rice paper until we asked for it. Will charge you for wet tissue. The only thing interesting in this restaurant is the interiors. Do yourself a favor and eat somewhere else. 😭

author: Trung Nguyen
review_text:
This isn’t a large place. It’s well decorated, very hip. The walls are made of brick so voices bounced quite a bit. Fortunately the patrons keeps the voice down, but unfortunately some the waiter would yell across the room breaking the silence.

The food average. Nothing stands out. Though the portion is generous amount of meat in comparison to others.

It appears to have 4 person in the front (waiters), I don’t know how many in the back. They are so so slow. My rice plate took forever and it wasn’t just off the grill, so don’t know why it took this long. Amazingly my Pepsi took longer than my rice plate. And the finally, my goi cuon came out last.

author: Jessica Le
review_text:
I had such an amazing experience dining here! From the moment I walked in, the staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive without being overbearing. The atmosphere was cozy yet modern, making it perfect for both a casual meal or a special occasion.
The food was absolutely outstanding — every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into the cooking. My personal favorites were Cơm Tấm, but honestly, everything we tried was delicious.
Service was quick and efficient, and the team made sure we always had what we needed. Prices are very reasonable for the portion sizes and the quality you get.

author: xin
review_text:
The deco and ambiance were nice, but it was very noisy inside. The food was average (as ive had better broken rice roadside stalls) and the cleanliness wasn’t great, I even found hair in my food.

The staff also need more training, as the service was quite poor. Overall, not the best experience.

author: Joe Kwong
review_text: In Saigon Centre, B2 floor (Ho Chi Ming city) you will find this little Vietnamese restaurant. Looks like they’re serving different broken rice here, it’s authentic and tasty. Besides, we found other dishes are really nice too, the taste of their food is just right and details, with reasonable price as well. Recommend.

author: Zoe Kay
review_text:
I’ve been in Vietnam for a couple of days and I couldn’t find anywhere that had that fresh vietnamese food i was looking for, until I found Com Tam Moc!!

I had a Vermicelli Noodle Salad with Pork and it was so amazing, exactly what I needed.

The staff didn’t speak much english but they always made sure you were okay and used Google Translate when needed.

100% Recommend

author: YAGIZ “CollageUSA Drive”
review_text: waitress was rude, chicken wasn't cooked enough (its risky for health), only good thing about restaurant was atmosphere but I pay for eaiting not atmosphere so 1 star only

author: Kien Tran (Kin)
review_text:
ok this one kinda nice cơm tấm (broken rice) spot i’ve hit in saigon recently, maybe the best for tourist. it’s a bit pricey for cơm tấm and def feels a little catered to tourists, but honestly… i’d still go back.

the sườn nướng (grilled pork chop) hits hard—perfectly caramelized edges, juicy inside, the marinade’s that sweet-savory goodness done right. the cơm (rice) itself’s fluffy and lightly fragrant, not dry like at other places. big win: they give plenty of mỡ hành (scallion oil) and mắm chấm (fish sauce dip), balanced just right—not too sugary, not too pungent. love that.

skip the soup unless you’re really craving side quests.

author: Ly Chou
review_text: definitely recommend this place, if you want to try Vietnamese food, they have a variety of foods n their staff are so nice, some can even speak a little bit of Khmer. The atmosphere is so cozy, not crowded too, WOULD COME HERE AGAINN⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Casey Chong
review_text: Nice atmosphere, food you can get anywhere nothing special but the service level is for local Vietnamese. Plenty empty free table and yet asked us to squeeze with other 2 seater tables

author: Bree Reeves
review_text:
10/10
Exposed brick wall, beautiful high ceiling, warm wood. I might have to keep ordering so I can stay here longer 😍
The food. Delicious!
(Ut khon) my server was helpful - service overall was friendly and well run.

author: Andrew Wong
review_text: Ordered the grilled chicken and steamed vegetables platter with braised fish sauce. Enjoyed the meal, place was cosy with fast service, price was reasonable considering it’s a restaurant with AC.

author: Stan Mellstrom
review_text:
The reviews on here are chatting absolute rubbish. i had the BEST meat dishes from here and the atmosphere is super chill. clean facilities and the workers did their best considering the language barrier.

Remember people always try for yourself!

author: The Laughing Lion
review_text:
I thought this place was good, not spectacular or bad, but good.
The flavors of the grilled pork chop were as expected. My only complaint was of the spring rolls. The rice paper they used was kind of tough. I am accustomed to soft spring rolls, so I was a bit surprised.
The dining room was basic and clean. The tables and chairs were all made of wood. I went for lunch and it was not very busy, so the service was really quick. The staff was friendly.
The prices are very reasonable here considering this is in a tourist zone.
I would definitely come back here and have a meal again.

author: Cindy Woon Lee Loo
review_text: Food is better than expected.. ribs , pork and vegs are delicious... with broken roce of course...

author: Thanh-Mai Nguyen
review_text: We had a delicious meal here. Food was tasty, staff was friendly, and the restaurant vibes were cool. Highly recommended

author: Jhon Melky Chumacera
review_text:
I recently had one of the best coffee experiences in Ho Chi Minh City at Trung Nguyên Legend Café on Alexandre de Rhodes — and it’s easily my favorite among the many branches in the area. What makes this location special isn’t just the coffee, it’s the whole atmosphere that feels both cozy and timeless.

The moment you sit down, you’re greeted by a space that somehow blends old-world charm with relaxed sophistication. The interior is warm and inviting, with comfortable seating that makes it perfect for lingering over a cup, while the outdoor seating lets you soak up the vibrant street life of Ho Chi Minh City without feeling rushed. Many other branches are nice, but here the setting feels particularly magical — like a cherished local secret where coffee culture is celebrated.

The coffee itself is exceptional. Trung Nguyên’s deep roots in Vietnamese coffee culture shine through in every sip, offering a rich, aromatic profile that exemplifies why this brand has become iconic.

Service is attentive without being intrusive, and even when busy, the pace doesn’t suffer. It’s the kind of place where you can enjoy both the buzz of the city and a moment of peace with a beautifully brewed coffee.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants a genuine, memorable coffee experience in HCMC.

author: An Le
review_text: This location is massive and very clean—definitely more of an upscale vibe if you need a break from the heat. The drip coffee is very strong (just how I like it) and the pastries were fresh. Picked up some beans as gifts too. Great spot to just sit and chill for a bit

author: Ryan G
review_text:
The Trying Legend Caffe is one of those rare places where you don’t simply come for a cup of coffee—you come for the experience. Tucked away in a corner of Ho Chi Minh City, it feels almost unreal how quickly the atmosphere shifts the moment you step inside. Despite being in the heart of one of the busiest and most energetic cities in Asia, the café somehow creates a peaceful bubble that makes you forget the traffic, the pace, and the noise outside. It’s the perfect spot to slow down, breathe, and simply be present.

The colours of the space immediately set the tone. Warm earthy tones mixed with thoughtful accents give the café a calm, inviting charm. Every detail—from the lighting to the layout—feels intentionally chosen to help visitors unwind. But it’s the flavours that truly elevate the experience. Each drink is crafted with care, whether you go for a classic Vietnamese brew or one of their more unique signature creations. The balance, the aroma, and the richness are consistently impressive.

What truly sets The Trying Legend Caffe apart, though, is the level of experience they offer. The staff are kind and attentive, the ambiance is soothing, and every visit feels special. It’s beyond amazing—an oasis in a bustling city, and absolutely worth returning to.

author: Tia
review_text:
We visited this café because it was very eye-catching, and it definitely delivers on atmosphere. The space is elegant and pleasant, and the coffee was genuinely amazing.

The only downside for us was the presentation of the food. We ordered the sunny-side egg bánh mì and it arrived deconstructed, which we weren’t expecting. While the flavours were good, we weren’t provided with a knife to cut the bread and assemble it ourselves, which made the whole experience a bit messy and more complicated than it needed to be.

Overall, the café has a great vibe and excellent coffee, but a little more attention to food presentation and basic cutlery would really improve the experience.

author: cindy ngo
review_text:
If you are a coffee lover then you should try to see if you can take a strongest coffee here or not as it is a very special coffee represented to Vietnamese  coffee culture.

Price: acceptable

Location: located at the city center which is from the coffee shop you can walk around the park the heart of the city, as well as independence palace, Catholic Church, diamond plaza around 5’ walk.

Event for: family gathering, friends meeting even business meeting also fine as it is not so noise and I saw there was a private meeting area available as well.

In conclusion, it is a good place for tourism or even local relaxation.

author: And S
review_text: Went to this outlet of legend cafe not knowing it is a chain. You go for the experience, it’s a bit pricey but has a nice atmosphere. Service is a bit slow. Had the legend coffee which is a drip coffee in an espresso cup. With 189k VND it’s very expensive, but comes on a nice tray and is supposedly made of fermented coffee beans. Taste was exceptional.

author: Ibizian Ibizian
review_text:
This place is amazing. The service is definitely 5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐. They brought us a menu and some very delicious tea. Those cups were never empty. They made sure you had tea, and that's before you even order and after you've had your coffee and food and are just relaxing. The tea kept coming!

The coffee... What can be said about Vietnamese coffee that the world doesn't already know!

Presentation was great for first timers. They taught her how to process and then drink her coffee. And of course it was unlike any coffee at home!

Definitely a place to pop in, get some AC and chill!

World class!

author: Hoàng Quỳnh
review_text:
This Trung Nguyên spot near Notre-Dame Cathedral is a familiar name in the area. It’s been around for quite a while and offers a classic setting, especially convenient if you’re meeting someone in the city center.

One plus: They offer table service – you order at your seat and pay after, which is convenient and makes things smoother when you’re hosting guests.

But the downsides?
• Mosquitoes. Yes, even when you’re sitting in air-conditioned areas, you’re still getting bitten. No joke.
• Staffing is thin – sometimes it’s hard to get a waiter’s attention.
• And of course, Trung Nguyên prices are no joke – drinks can be pricier than Starbucks or most high-end coffee chains.

Overall: Great location and service concept, but between the high prices and the uninvited mosquito guests (yes, even indoors), it’s more of a once-in-a-while stop than a regular hangout.

author: Tita Pizza
review_text:
This coffee shop caught our attention due to its numerous branches, prompting us to give it a try. We opted for the Zen coffee, which appeared to be their specialty, but it fell short of expectations, especially considering the steep price of VND 189,000. Given its status as a specialty coffee shop, we anticipated a more engaging experience. However, the server simply lit the burner and left without any explanation, leaving us unsure of how to enjoy the unique presentation.

The coffee itself was quite potent and not to our liking. On a brighter note, the Salt Coffee was enjoyable and somewhat redeemed the visit.

Overall, we wouldn’t highly recommend this place, as there are better coffee shops available.

Tip: If you're considering purchasing their packed coffee, it's more affordable at grocery stores like Co.OP Mart.

------

Warning for tourists: while crossing a pedestrian, we were suddenly "guided" by a local street peddler - we didn't ask for directions nor tell him where we were going but he just said "4 blocks away". I initially just said thank you because I had a bad feeling he will ask for something in return "in exchange" for the help. However, he suddenly talked to my companion and asked where we were from as we were walking. Before I knew it, we were being asked to pay for fresh coconut juice (VDN 150,000 each). He was so quick to open 2 coconuts that we didn't have a choice but as he was opening the 3rd one, we said "no need, just 2" but he got mad and proceeded to open the 3rd one anyway. All in all, we paid VDN 450,000 for 3 coconuts. Talk about highway robbery. So disappointing.

Lesson learned: really do not talk to strangers.

author: Zarina Kurtnizirova
review_text: I found shelter in this cafe when it started to rain. I like the way they serve their food. The coffee was good. I also ordered beef stew, it was so comforting in such weather. Absolutely recommend this place.

author: Nurul Hisham
review_text: We had some Vietnamese coffee and their special iced milked tea. They were super good. And we bought some coffee beans, coffee powders and a few coffee drip press or coffee filters to bring home as souvenirs ❤️

author: XianYan Wu
review_text:
Coconut pandan coffee is good. Banana pancake crepe is tasty but too small portion. Coffee was pretty good, we tried #5 and #4. #5 is better and balanced. #4 is more coffee and sweeter.

Environment is beautiful and tastefully designed. Free tea given to all guests. Spent 260k Dong for 3 drinks, 1 dessert.

author: Botak
review_text:
The review address for this should be:

7 Nguyễn Văn Chiêm, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Vietnam

Not sure how I should go about amending it

Love this place as a great place to chill and have my Vietnamese coffee, plus you can buy coffee souvenirs for friends before  leaving HCM

Personally, I prefer this compared to Starbucks and Coffee Bean as u get to see more locals and their families there.

But try not to go on weekends since it is normally quite difficult to get a seat.

Staff are polite and price slightly lower than the American chains.

A legend not to be missed.

author: Ekk Chawa
review_text:
This cafe is beautiful. The front is like mountain and forest and inside is like a library where the books replaced by coffee cans and bags. There's also an  elegant piano place in the center.
I ordered Napolian coffee and my colleague had dried Pho. The coffee was super strong and gave me energized for the rest of the day and Pho was delicious.
Good place for chilling or have a nice meal.

author: Eileen Reichenbächer
review_text: If you would like to try some delicious Vietnamese coffee specialities, then I can highly recommend this café. The menu offers selected drinks and dishes, although the price is a bit too high. The staff are friendly and happy to advise you on your choice. Enjoy your visit in a relaxed atmosphere with delicious coffee. ☕🍰

author: DONLAWAT PANRAT
review_text: The food and coffee are excellent, the service is friendly, and the location is nice. It's also pleasantly cool inside thanks to the air conditioning.

author: Rapin P
review_text:
Mosquito lots on second floor ,
Food quality and coffee price . Really not for me :-( sorry

author: Bas Barath
review_text:
I didn't enjoy their legendary signature coffee. Firstly, it took 30 mins to get my drink due to mixup, and then the drip coffee takes more than 15 mins to actually drip into the cup through the filter. I didn't get my cake either, and they couldn't be bothered to at least tell me they were out of it.

I guess, if you have plenty of time in your hand, this may be a nice place to hang out. It's hard to be a patron here with limited time.

author: Adrian Nc
review_text:
Drink is good.
Price is more than high - almost 10 times compare to the cheapest one - but reasonable as its trademark and location.
But the most inconvenient thing is hardly to find a power socket (next to your seat) to charge the phone or laptop

author: Khoa Do
review_text: Good location to begin your day with a delicious coffee and breakfast. Nice decoration with separate spaces, inside for ppl who wanna have business talk or a reunion of old friend; Outside with park view for whom wanna take a breath of fresh air in the morning. Bike parking is always available. Recommend coming at Morning.

author: LML
review_text: After learning that Michelin awarded this restaurant a Bib Gourmand, I had to try it—and it did not disappoint. The phở gà was excellent, with a rich, flavorful broth. The restaurant was packed with locals, which added to the authenticity of the experience. I ordered a small portion after reading reviews that mentioned the generous sizing, and it was indeed more than sufficient.

author: Holland Mills
review_text:
We did not have this location on our radar prior to a recommendation from our friends at Cà Phê X, but it's firmly on there now!

Down a side alley and nearby the aforementioned Coffee experience, this unassuming eatery has been an institution of Hanoi style Chicken Phở for over 25 years!

We really enjoyed the flavorful no-frills broth, the herbs and fixings served alongside, and the opportunity to see the entire operation at work during our meal.

The pricing is very affordable, and the meal is filling. It wasn't until after our visit that I noticed the Bib Gourmand awards on their wall, almost delivery tucked away from the main event.

We'll be looking forward to our return here next time we are in HCMC!

author: naengbu
review_text:
Classic Pho Ga! 🍜🇻🇳
I had to stop by the famous michelin bib restaurant serving chicken pho in HCMC. You know it’s gonna be good when the place is filled with locals.

I ordered their signature dish: Pho Ga (Chicken Pho). As an Indonesian, this is a dish  resembles a dish called soto ayam back home. A simple warm dish, just noodles, chicken and aromatics. Perfect for a rainy day. The chicken was cooked to perfection, tender and fulfilling. The broth was extremely rich, too rich for my liking, which put me off from finishing the broth. I added condiments and leaves they provided to really elevate the experience.

Despite its reputation, the prices were still reasonable, and the portion sizes were generous, a great value meal. We left barely able to walk.

The service was top notch. Even though we were the only tourists, they served us well and were VERY attentive. None of them spoke English, but they still tried their best to accommodate us 🫶🏻🙌🏻. We often feel out of place in Vietnam, but they made us feel welcomed. They took cleanliness seriously too.

It’s a little far from district 1, but I recommend making the trip if you’re ever nearby. See you again👏🏻

author: Cindy Woon Lee Loo
review_text: Had the beef Pho, spring rolls etc. The broth is good and you can add your own vegs into your bowl. Overall its yummy and per serving is quite big for an Asian serving.. need to take Grab to get there..

author: Lionel Lim
review_text: First visit to this famous Chicken Pho and I was not disappointed at all. The bowl of chicken Pho might look plain but once you start, you will realize why this place received so much accolades. The broth is light and flavorful, very tasty and goes very well with the noodle and chicken parts.

author: Wahlin Lee
review_text: We liked the pho here very much! The broth is very flavorful. It has a very subtle hint of chicken, but after squeezing in some calamansi, the flavor was elevated, becoming beautifully clear and sweet.  We will come back for sure.

author: Jane Le
review_text:
Chicken Noodle – Michelin Guide

Every time I visit Vietnam, I make sure to stop by this chicken noodle shop. The chicken here isn’t as soft as what you might find in Singapore, as they use local farm chicken, giving it a firmer texture — especially in the salad and noodle dishes.

I also recommend trying the fresh sugar cane juice. On my latest visit, I tried the guava juice with sour plum too — it was freshly made and really refreshing!

author: YUUKI SUGIYAMA
review_text:
My visit to Phở Miến Gà Kỳ Đồng was a long-awaited treat. Despite it being on my list since day one, the fun of travelling with friends meant I only managed to get here on my last day in Ho Chi Minh City. Yet, the anticipation was well worth it.

As a Michelin recommended eatery, I naturally had to try their signature dish: the chicken pho. The soup base was what truly sets it apart. It was incredibly rich and hearty, yet surprisingly clean and sweet on the palate, a testament to hours of careful simmering. Each spoonful felt nourishing and deeply satisfying. The chicken was cooked to perfection so tender and succulent it practically melted in my mouth.

To elevate the experience, I added some fresh basil leaves, which brightened the broth with a lovely, fragrant lift. A splash of fish sauce introduced a new layer of complexity, adding a savory depth that transformed the flavour profile entirely.

Despite its prestigious recommendation, the prices here are astonishingly reasonable. I was genuinely surprised when a bowl of their famous chicken pho and a drink came to just 85,000 VND. It's an incredible value for such a high-quality meal.

This place is an absolute must-visit for anyone in Saigon. It’s an unforgettable culinary experience that proves great food doesn't have to be expensive. I’ll definitely be making a return visit on my next trip to the city.

author: The MY World
review_text: It's Phở and Miến restaurant, which was selected as Bib Gurment by Michelin. I remember that it was located on the very small street, but after few years, the steet was a bit developped and cleaner than before. Anyway there are many tables, so you don't need to worry for the table. You can have. We had Pho and Mien, then Pho 's soup came with fried garlic and the Mien's soup came with Onion, so it tastes a bit different but the base was same. Then the soup was awsome.
